Peter — Wisconsin’s gold standard pollster, Marquette Law, just released its second poll of our Senate race. Their **Pledge Letter** promises to _oppose_ : ❌ Any new funding bills for Joe Biden's weaponized Administration;

Peter, it’s Jon Tester. My campaign is approaching our first major test of the general election, and I need your help. I’ll explain more in a second, but first: [_**Will you split a donation between my campaign and Fight for Progress to help us reach our must-hit end-of-quarter fundraising goal?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87675032/481917971/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-06-26_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZhNmRmOTNkLTFmMzQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TjayWyQ5uBsxMc3GGXxXkA-wgeV78d68hJxkpGy8BOI=)

June has marked a major turning point for our campaign. We officially have an opponent, won our first debate, and now have our first FEC deadline of the general election. **We need to be building momentum, but instead our fundraising has slowed down at the worst possible time.**

Mitch McConnell and his super PAC allies are spending nearly $65 million to tear us down, and if our fundraising numbers look weak, they’ll take that as a sign to bury us in ads.

**That’s why we’ve set an ambitious goal of raising _$1 million_ before our FEC deadline. It won’t be easy, but if we want to win this race, we have to aim high. We can’t afford to play it safe, and we can’t afford to come up short.**
[_**I need your help to win this thing, so I’m personally asking: Can I count on you to split a contribution between my campaign and Fight for Progress to send the message to Mitch McConnell and his megadonors that Montana can’t be bought?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87675036/481917973/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-06-26_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZhNmRmOTNkLTFmMzQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TjayWyQ5uBsxMc3GGXxXkA-wgeV78d68hJxkpGy8BOI=)
This race is about more than just a Senate seat to me. **It’s personal**. It’s about defending Montana from wealthy outsiders like my opponent, who think their money and influence entitle them to treat this state like their personal playground and buy themselves a Senate seat to boot.

Montana’s been my home my whole life, and I’ll always fight for our values. But I can’t win this race without your help, so please: [_**Split a donation today so I can keep fighting for Montanans in the Senate.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87675039/481917977/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-06-26_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZhNmRmOTNkLTFmMzQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TjayWyQ5uBsxMc3GGXxXkA-wgeV78d68hJxkpGy8BOI=)

Thanks,

Jon Tester

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week:
Last week was a busy one! I spoke with the: -Western Iowa Labor Federation via Zoom -Dickinson Co Dems in Arnolds Park -ISEA via Zoom for their endorsement interview -West Central Iowa Fundraiser attendees in Denison -Iowa Democratic Party Climate Caucus via Zoom -Iowa Democratic Party Hall of Fame event attendees in Ames -Boone Co Democrats in Madrid at Swede Point park -Fort Dodge Pride attendees -Calhoun Co Democrats in Rockwell City -and capped the week off by attending a Juneteenth event and helping with sandbagging in Fort Dodge.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week:
There were two predominant issues of note that arose last week and this week that I'd like to touch upon here. First, the flooding last week in Northern Iowa was heartbreaking. Many 4th Congressional District communities were hit really hard. My heart goes out to our friends there. With the flooding came talk of Iowa's infrastructure, namely our many levees and dams in need of repair, a long known issue along with our nation-leading number of bridges in need of repair that leave us incredibly vulnerable to more severe damage from natural disasters. Per the article link below, my opponent Randy Feenstra requested $0.00 yet again for the 4th year in a row per the annual projects earmark appropriation process in Congress. He continues to leave us further and further behind in the 4th, despite the fact the other 3 U.S. House Republicans requested $115 million collectively this year for projects to revitalize their communities. With the massive hollowing out of our district, where most of our 36 counties have seen decades-long population decline, it is unacceptable that Feenstra is doing the exact opposite of what any member of Congress should be doing to advocate for their constituents. If elected, I would invest in our communities and our people.
Second, the Gov. Reynolds hand-picked Iowa Utilities Board approved Summit's eminent domain request for their carbon capture pipelines this week. I was arguably the first candidate for office in Iowa that ran against the pipelines back in January 2022. At the time, I was often a man on an island in that effort, being discouraged from doing so by some in my own party. Regardless, I pushed forward, feeling strong in my justification. I've run against the pipelines ever since, pulling the state party over to my position, for many reasons I've documented here in my weekly newsletters. Those include the eminent domain abuse these pipelines would bring, the threat posed to rural communities by a CO2 pipeline fracture (for reference, google the fracture in Satartia, MS that hospitalized dozens), the massive water use requirement of these pipelines in a state working its way out of a multiyear drought (The SIerra Club estimates a usage rate of 3.6 billion gallons of water along the Summit route per year), the fact these pipelines and the carbon sequestration tech attached to them have historically severely underperformed in carbon emissions reduction and are therefore a waste of taxpayer money, and the concern I have that these pipelines would more firmly entrench the farmers of this state in the ethanol status quo when ethanol is going to be on more and more uncertain ground considering the electrification of our vehicle fleet. The Sierra Club and Bold Alliance, two groups at the forefront of fighting these pipelines, said after the IUB decision that this battle is far from over, as appeals and lawsuits will be submitted. I'll continue to fight the good fight on this front. Feenstra, meanwhile, made no statement regarding the IUB decision. Considering Summit's Bruce Rastetter has donated tens of thousands to Feenstra, along with Feenstra's support for the pipelines, this isn't a surprise.
Our schedule for this week: -On Tuesday 6/25, I doorknocked and sign dropped in Story County in Roland, Story City, Maxwell, Huxley, Nevada, and Ames. -On Wednesday 6/26, I spoke with a great crowd in Webster City at West Twin Park. -On Thursday 6/27, I'll be in State Center at Kauffman Shelter from 630-830. -On Saturday 6/29 from 2-8, I'll be at the LULAC immigrant heritage parade and festival in Denison. -On Sunday 6/30, I'll be at Pizza Ranch in Storm Lake at 2 and at the Pizza Ranch in Pocahontas at 430.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://qctimes.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/article_9b5922ba-2432-11ef-967f-53295fa028ec.html
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

clean_body: | | | | == | == | Melton for Iowa 2024 | Hello Peter, This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc. Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week was a busy one! I spoke with the: -Western Iowa Labor Federation via Zoom -Dickinson Co Dems in Arnolds Park -ISEA via Zoom for their endorsement interview -West Central Iowa Fundraiser attendees in Denison -Iowa Democratic Party Climate Caucus via Zoom -Iowa Democratic Party Hall of Fame event attendees in Ames -Boone Co Democrats in Madrid at Swede Point park -Fort Dodge Pride attendees -Calhoun Co Democrats in Rockwell City -and capped the week off by attending a Juneteenth event and helping with sandbagging in Fort Dodge. The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: There were two predominant issues of note that arose last week and this week that I'd like to touch upon here. First, the flooding last week in Northern Iowa was heartbreaking. Many 4th Congressional District communities were hit really hard. My heart goes out to our friends there. With the flooding came talk of Iowa's infrastructure, namely our many levees and dams in need of repair, a long known issue along with our nation-leading number of bridges in need of repair that leave us incredibly vulnerable to more severe damage from natural disasters. Per the article link below, my opponent Randy Feenstra requested $0.00 yet again for the 4th year in a row per the annual projects earmark appropriation process in Congress. He continues to leave us further and further behind in the 4th, despite the fact the other 3 U.S. House Republicans requested $115 million collectively this year for projects to revitalize their communities. With the massive hollowing out of our district, where most of our 36 counties have seen decades-long population decline, it is unacceptable that Feenstra is doing the exact opposite of what any member of Congress should be doing to advocate for their constituents. If elected, I would invest in our communities and our people. Second, the Gov. Reynolds hand-picked Iowa Utilities Board approved Summit's eminent domain request for their carbon capture pipelines this week. I was arguably the first candidate for office in Iowa that ran against the pipelines back in January 2022. At the time, I was often a man on an island in that effort, being discouraged from doing so by some in my own party. Regardless, I pushed forward, feeling strong in my justification. I've run against the pipelines ever since, pulling the state party over to my position, for many reasons I've documented here in my weekly newsletters. Those include the eminent domain abuse these pipelines would bring, the threat posed to rural communities by a CO2 pipeline fracture (for reference, google the fracture in Satartia, MS that hospitalized dozens), the massive water use requirement of these pipelines in a state working its way out of a multiyear drought (The SIerra Club estimates a usage rate of 3.6 billion gallons of water along the Summit route per year), the fact these pipelines and the carbon sequestration tech attached to them have historically severely underperformed in carbon emissions reduction and are therefore a waste of taxpayer money, and the concern I have that these pipelines would more firmly entrench the farmers of this state in the ethanol status quo when ethanol is going to be on more and more uncertain ground considering the electrification of our vehicle fleet. The Sierra Club and Bold Alliance, two groups at the forefront of fighting these pipelines, said after the IUB decision that this battle is far from over, as appeals and lawsuits will be submitted. I'll continue to fight the good fight on this front. Feenstra, meanwhile, made no statement regarding the IUB decision. Considering Summit's Bruce Rastetter has donated tens of thousands to Feenstra, along with Feenstra's support for the pipelines, this isn't a surprise. Our schedule for this week: -On Tuesday 6/25, I doorknocked and sign dropped in Story County in Roland, Story City, Maxwell, Huxley, Nevada, and Ames. -On Wednesday 6/26, I spoke with a great crowd in Webster City at West Twin Park. -On Thursday 6/27, I'll be in State Center at Kauffman Shelter from 630-830. -On Saturday 6/29 from 2-8, I'll be at the LULAC immigrant heritage parade and festival in Denison. -On Sunday 6/30, I'll be at Pizza Ranch in Storm Lake at 2 and at the Pizza Ranch in Pocahontas at 430. Recent press/social media posts of note: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com! Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton == | | | | | | | | == | == == == | == | P.O. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Our expunction clinic tour is coming to HOUSTON / Nuestro recorrido por la clínica de expunción llega a HOUSTON
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
THIS SATURDAY:
Helping clear records and create opportunities for Houstonians
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Record%20expunged.jpg]
Fresh off a successful clinic this past weekend in San Antonio, join TOP and community allies Saturday, June 29 from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m. for a FREE event at the Houston TOP office (1610 Dumble St.) dedicated to providing resources, information, and support for individuals seeking expungements to clear their criminal records. Our Right2Justice team is partnering with Easy Expunctions to guide applicants through the process, offering insights, assistance, and potential opportunity to have your record cleared.
Attendees will gain valuable info and also a sense of community, support, as well as a place to get involved in our fight for mass liberation. Don't miss this opportunity to take a significant step toward a brighter future for yourself or a loved one. Register today and let us help you navigate your path toward expungement.
REGISTER HERE! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf9V-HdLRxiywUd4uniuPX2BJaP5sW6MP3Np-GybVcEFhwBPw/viewform]
Commemorating Juneteenth with reflection and community-building
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Juneteenth%20event%202024.jpg]
Reimagining a Texas where each and every one of us can live free and thrive starts with trust, connection, and heartfelt dialogue.
Channeling the spirit of Juneteenth, TOP staff and members teamed up with Houston Justice on Saturday, for an intimate community event featuring the screening of the documentary TEXAS, USA . Learn more about this documentary which highlights the work of BlackTOP. [https://www.texasusafilm.com/]
After the screening, Terrance "TK" Koontz, TOP’s Culture and Organizational Development Director, shared his compelling life journey to becoming an organizer with us.
For more information about TOP’s new Culture and Organizational Development Team, get in contact with TK at tkoontz@organizetexas.org [tkoontz@organizetexas.org] .
Taking time to recharge as we lock in for the rest of 2024
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20group%20pic.jpg]
TOP offices will be closed July 1 - 5 , as we take a moment to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for an action-packed rest of 2024 filled with getting out the vote and ramping up our issue-based campaigns. You can still keep in touch with us online, though! Remember to give TOP a follow on the following platforms:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/organizetexas/]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/OrganizeTexas]
TikTok [https://tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
YouTube [https://www.youtube.com/@organizetexas/videos]
TOP Tip: Get creative with summer family-fun activities for the kids
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20father%20and%20child.png]
For many Texans with kids, there's still a month and a half of summer break remaining! Wondering what family-friendly activities you can do with your little ones this summertime to have some fun? Check out this list of low-cost summer activities for young children. [https://parade.com/1245931/marynliles/summer-activities/]
Español
ESTE SÁBADO:
Ayudando a limpiar registros y crear oportunidades para los residentes de Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Record%20expunged.jpg]
Recién salido de una clínica exitosa el fin de semana pasado en San Antonio, únase a TOP y a los aliados de la comunidad el sábado 29 de junio de 11 a.m. a 2 p.m. para un evento GRATUITO en la oficina de TOP en Houston (1610 Dumble St.) dedicado a brindar recursos, información y apoyo a personas que buscan borrar sus antecedentes penales. Nuestro equipo de Right2Justice se está asociando con Easy Expunctions para guiar a los solicitantes a través del proceso, ofreciendo información, asistencia y oportunidades potenciales para que se borre su historial.
Los asistentes obtendrán información valiosa y también un sentido de comunidad, apoyo y un lugar para involucrarse en nuestra lucha por la liberación masiva. No pierda esta oportunidad de dar un paso importante hacia un futuro mejor para usted o un ser querido. Regístrese hoy y permítanos ayudarle a recorrer su camino hacia la eliminación de antecedentes penales.
¡REGISTRAR AQUÍ! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf9V-HdLRxiywUd4uniuPX2BJaP5sW6MP3Np-GybVcEFhwBPw/viewform]
Conmemorando el Juneteenth con reflexión y construcción comunitaria
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Juneteenth%20event%202024.jpg]
Reimaginar un Texas donde todos y cada uno de nosotros podamos vivir libres y prosperar comienza con la confianza, la conexión y el diálogo sincero.
Canalizando el espíritu de Juneteenth, el personal y los miembros de TOP se asociaron con Houston Justice el sábado para un evento comunitario íntimo que presentó la proyección del documental TEXAS, USA . Conozca más sobre este documental que destaca el trabajo de BlackTOP. [https://www.texasusafilm.com/]
Después de la proyección, Terrance "TK" Koontz, director de cultura y desarrollo organizacional de TOP, compartió con nosotros su apasionante viaje de vida para convertirse en organizador.
P ara obtener más información sobre el nuevo Equipo de Cultura y Desarrollo Organizacional de TOP, póngase en contacto con TK en tkoontz@organizetexas.org. [tkoontz@organizetexas.org.]
Dedicando tiempo a recargarnos mientras nos fijamos para el resto de 2024
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20group%20pic.jpg]
Las oficinas de TOP estarán cerradas del 1 al 5 de julio , mientras nos tomamos un momento para descansar, rejuvenecer y prepararnos para un resto de 2024 lleno de acción, con esfuerzos para promover el voto y la intensificación de nuestras campañas basadas en temas. ¡Sin embargo, aún puedes mantenerte en contacto con nosotros en línea! Recuerda seguir a TOP en las siguientes plataformas:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/organizetexas/]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/OrganizeTexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
YouTube [https://www.youtube.com/@organizetexas/videos]
Consejos de TOP: Sea creativo con actividades de verano divertidas para la familia para los niños
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20father%20and%20child.png]
Para muchos tejanos con niños, ¡todavía queda un mes y medio de vacaciones de verano! ¿Te preguntas qué actividades familiares puedes hacer con tus pequeños este verano para divertirse? Consulte esta lista de actividades de verano de bajo costo para niños pequeños. [https://parade.com/1245931/marynliles/summer-activities/]

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: fwd: another one bites the dust
body:
I have some important news to share with you...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m forwarding an email I sent you last week because I have a **_HUGE_** update to it!

Last year, a handful of South Carolina Republican State Senators joined with Democrats in stonewalling our _Life at Conception Act,_ which would have abolished abortion in the Palmetto State.

Three were up for reelection this year.

Just two weeks ago – _after Students for Life Action activists knocked on thousands of doors in their districts, handed out hundreds of flyers at churches, and made even more calls, texts, and emails_ – TWO of the three **_LOST_** in their primary elections!

And the third one, Senator Katrina Shealy, was left facing a runoff election that was scheduled for yesterday . . .

**Pro-Life Friend, pro-lifers are now THREE for THREE!**

_. . . And now the Abortion Lobby is panicking!_

In fact, _The Guardian_ is now reporting, _“Complete Abortion Ban in South Carolina More Likely After Primaries.”_

Thanks to the support of good folks like you, we were able to put everything we had into this runoff election to make sure voters in Sen. Shealy’s district know how she stabbed pro-lifers in the back.

And because of these efforts, Sen. Shealy was **trounced** so badly that she wasn’t even able to pick up 40% of the vote!

Hopefully this just proves how big of an impact your support for our work has on Life across the country!

And it sends a strong signal to the leaders of the GOP that this Pro-Life Generation means business when we demand Republicans live up to our pro-life principles.

So, thank you and keep up everything you’re doing for Life – _because it’s working!_

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

[**DONATE TO _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION_ HERE**](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykxjy-duchtdja-y/)
_\-----Begin Forwarded Message-----_

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

You never hear when pro-lifers win from the pro-abortion media.

But thanks to your support, pro-lifers just had some incredible victories during South Carolina’s primary elections yesterday!

Last night, **_TWO_** South Carolina Senate Republicans who betrayed pro-lifers in stonewalling our _Life at Conception Act_ which would have ended abortion in the Palmetto state, just LOST in their primaries.

_And a** _THIRD_** one will face a runoff in two weeks!_

Media elites are FURIOUS!

You see, after a group of South Carolina Republicans joined forces with Planned Parenthood to KILL our _Life at Conception Act in 2023, The New York Times_ did everything they could to paint these traitors as heroes.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykxjy-duchtdja-j/)
These Republicans that pro-lifers just beat are among the same “Sister Senators” this headline posted by _The New York Times_ not long ago is referring to.

They’re the same women who our students delivered “Grow a Spine” awards to, asking them to stand up to _Planned Parenthood,_ and who laughed and called us names from the floor of the Senate (here's the photo proof).
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykxjy-duchtdja-i/)
But as of last night, one of them, Senator Penry Gustafson, was beaten very badly.

And after _Students for Life Action’s_ field team knocked on 1,134 doors in her district, another one, Senator Sandy Senn, lost by only 31 votes!

With two of these three **_GONE_** – _and pro-lifers gearing to kick the third to the curb as well_ – we’ll have a real chance at finally passing our _Life at Conception Act_ in South Carolina in 2025.

**_So, who’s laughing now?_**

But even after our victories last night, we can’t celebrate just yet . . .

We have to put everything we’ve got into this runoff election to make sure voters in Republican Senator Katrina Shealy’s district know how she’s stabbed pro-life voters and preborn babies in the back.

Pro-Life Friend, these victories are going to help us take some BIG steps forward in our effort to save lives.

And they’ll also show national GOP types who are considering weakening the RNC platform on Life what a disaster that would be for them in their primaries – _and in November!_

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action’s_ election efforts so we can deal the final blow to the Abortion Lobby in South Carolina](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykxjy-duchtdja-d/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

In fact, The Guardian is now reporting, “Complete Abortion Ban in South Carolina More Likely After Primaries.” Thanks to the support of good folks like you, we were able to put everything we had into this runoff election to make sure voters in Sen. Shealy’s district know how she stabbed pro-lifers in the back. And because of these efforts, Sen. Shealy was trounced so badly that she wasn’t even able to pick up 40% of the vote! Hopefully this just proves how big of an impact your support for our work has on Life across the country! And it sends a strong signal to the leaders of the GOP that this Pro-Life Generation means business when we demand Republicans live up to our pro-life principles. So, thank you and keep up everything you’re doing for Life – because it’s working! For Life, Kristan Hawkins President, Students for Life Action \-----Begin Forwarded Message----- Dear Pro-Life Friend, You never hear when pro-lifers win from the pro-abortion media. But thanks to your support, pro-lifers just had some incredible victories during South Carolina’s primary elections yesterday! Last night, TWO South Carolina Senate Republicans who betrayed pro-lifers in stonewalling our Life at Conception Act which would have ended abortion in the Palmetto state, just LOST in their primaries. And a THIRD one will face a runoff in two weeks! Media elites are FURIOUS! You see, after a group of South Carolina Republicans joined forces with Planned Parenthood to KILL our Life at Conception Act in 2023, The New York Times did everything they could to paint these traitors as heroes. These Republicans that pro-lifers just beat are among the same “Sister Senators” this headline posted by The New York Times not long ago is referring to. They’re the same women who our students delivered “Grow a Spine” awards to, asking them to stand up to Planned Parenthood, and who laughed and called us names from the floor of the Senate (here's the photo proof). But as of last night, one of them, Senator Penry Gustafson, was beaten very badly. And after Students for Life Action’s field team knocked on 1,134 doors in her district, another one, Senator Sandy Senn, lost by only 31 votes! With two of these three GONE – and pro-lifers gearing to kick the third to the curb as well – we’ll have a real chance at finally passing our Life at Conception Act in South Carolina in 2025. So, who’s laughing now? But even after our victories last night, we can’t celebrate just yet . . . We have to put everything we’ve got into this runoff election to make sure voters in Republican Senator Katrina Shealy’s district know how she’s stabbed pro-life voters and preborn babies in the back. Pro-Life Friend, these victories are going to help us take some BIG steps forward in our effort to save lives. And they’ll also show national GOP types who are considering weakening the RNC platform on Life what a disaster that would be for them in their primaries – and in November! ? name: Hillsdale College via ICYMI News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbdg857p4adjfegj6pp4ojdl38l4vil2ke06g4l8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge4ob5cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf89fpj96pna5d3cce92cjr17nethc959vho74u8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge2oj6clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zccct23gsn5m7hg2id38ille13m75tk0p19o9p7o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge2oj6clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zla4cjm095arv7doi9vhhi356llpuc8snl2q00po_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge2oj6clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze66stliiiqjheg14krca1apgdeadbmejppc5af8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge6o32cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8mrhm0nmhs5oghde55g8cb08em1g8h2d1v3m540_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge6o32cjh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znl47fkj67jqaesmseuc3afmib1q02v28upo9j28_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge6o32cjh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

# NEWS
Join us for an amazing evening of fellowship and patriotism! See you there, and God bless America!
Derrick & Nena Gates

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Your America is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zk5jkfosj7kmievajjnl9c8j5ps1qi2jjf0k3uc0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge1pr6clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmq54th3o1te47ucutph6edvftess8mu4njf5cp8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge1pr6clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z67erok91jscpoisr2grbf8uh3o8altoahjvetig_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge1pr6clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zdbm3pntatu03ajvlm81pritr347ieiifmn2db50_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5ge1pr6clh2bs)**

name: Katrina Pierson
subject: 4th of July Parades - Please Join Us
body:
Ready to kick-start summer with Team Katrina? Well, we have some great
opportunities to come together! But first, we want to make you aware of a
few things to help you stay informed about Team Katrina as we continue to
grow.

1. For those of you on X, please be sure you follow the new Team Katrina
page at https://x.com/TeamKatrinaTX

2. Please be sure you check on the events page of our website for lots
of upcoming events, along with a special celebration (coming soon)!
https://www.tickettailor.com/events/katrinapiersonfortexas

Ok, now let’s talk about *Independence Day/July 4th*!!! We are
participating in both the *Heath Independence Day Parade, and the City of
Rockwall 4th of July Parade*. Best part is, we want you to come join us!
We welcome everyone to both events; however, we do need to be sure that we
have 15-20 people in Rockwall at Wilkerson Sanders Stadium to prepare and
secure the decorations on the float trailer at 9:15. This is an exciting
event, and we encourage you to bring your family, kids, grandkids, friends,
co-workers or even your neighbors! We are still in campaign mode, our
grassroots movement is growing and the road to Austin has been paved with
your support so let’s keep moving!

You can find more details on each of the parades by using the links below,
and RSVP to each event individually! Please note that the Heath Parade is
walkers only, while Rockwall Parade we will have a large float to ride on,
as well as walkers. We encourage you to wear your Team Katrina shirts
and/or hats, Patriotic Clothing or Colors (red/white/blue).

*Heath Parade *

*Details * https://buytickets.at/katrinapiersonfortexas/1303224

*City of Rockwall Parade *

*Details* https://buytickets.at/katrinapiersonfortexas/1304215

*Looking forward to seeing you on July 4th, let’s have some fun!!!*

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: the battle has already begun
body:
It's showtime for the Pro-Life Movement...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

President Joe Biden and his pals in the Abortion Lobby are banking everything on abortion.

With the first presidential debate scheduled for **TOMORROW,** Americans are just now starting to tune in to everything that’s at stake in 2024.

And with the June 30th **End of Quarter** rapidly approaching, the Abortion Lobby is sniffing around the Pro-Life Movement.

They want to know if the Pro-Life Movement has the funding and the grassroots energy to beat them this November.

Pro-Life Friend, it’s time to shift this thing into high gear!

**[So, can I count on you to make your most generous contribution towards _Students for Life Action’s_ June 30th **End of Quarter Push** right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwsjt-duchtdja-y/)?**
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwsjt-duchtdja-j/)
Your support right now would be such a HUGE help.

You see Pro-Life Friend, while the media is glued to the race for the White House _(which is critical),_ that’s not all we have on our plates . . .

As you know, there are multiple pro-abortion state ballot initiatives that could mean life or death for countless babies across the country.

We’re already busy IN ALL of them, but we have to do more – especially in:
** \- Florida
\- Montana
\- Arizona
\- Nebraska \- Nevada
\- Arkansas
\- Missouri
\- South Dakota **

Your support for our efforts today will make a tremendous impact in all these states.

With your help, _Students for Life Action_ is:

**>>> _Reaching into a QUARTER MILLION Homes with our "Almost Aborted" Commercials_** in referendum states, which shine a spotlight on the lies of the Abortion Lobby and their hundreds of millions of dollars they are using to launch deceptive campaigns to pass late-term abortion constitutional amendments, using “rape” and “prenatal diagnoses” as the excuse to justify 100% of abortions – _including late-term._
**>>> _Sharing Ballot Referendum Kits_** which are designed to help push back against ballot initiatives and signature collection efforts undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country! These kits given to grassroots voounteers include 200 Door Hangers, 50 Topic Cards, 50 Church Bulletins, and hundreds of more activism materials.
**>>> _Hitting College Campuses in Referendum States_** where we'll be showing the movie _Unplanned_ on our Pro-Life Billboard Truck, which is one of our most effective tools in converting young people to the Pro-Life Movement ahead of November!
**>>> _Deploying a Massive Door-Knocking Blitz_** across targeted referendum states designed to tell voters the TRUTH about the cruelty of the Abortion Lobby. Our activists knock on hundreds of doors until their knuckles are sore while handing out our literature about what's at stake with proposed abortion amendments.
Pro-Life Friend, we can stand up to the Abortion Lobby and beat them in these states – especially when we actually have Republicans fighting alongside us _(and not running away)._

One of those states is Florida where Governor Ron DeSantis continues to stand strong for the Sunshine State’s _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law._

In fact, here’s what our door-knockers had to say about their recent deployment in Florida:

_“My experience with door knocking in Naples was a blessed one. After talking to a lot of people about the horrors of abortion and changing a few minds, it felt amazing knowing that I did my part in trying to make this world a better place for the preborn. I hope we get to do more such events to try and spread as much awareness as possible.”_
**-** Sujay Gaurav, student at _Florida International University_
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwsjt-duchtdja-i/) _"Students for Life Action's Naples/Bonita Springs FL deployment built camaraderie between the volunteers who attended, as we fought for those who cannot defend themselves. I was surprised how many voters were not really informed on Amendment 4 that will be on the ballot. I am glad to have volunteered with SFLAction and am impressed by how the people are passionate about conservative values. Always proud to serve in any capacity."_
**-** Jose Sanchez, Ret. MSgt USAF
_“I had one fellow that saw my shirt and said, ‘I am 100% pro-life. I was adopted. And I like to believe the world doesn't need abortion because it is full of people like my parents – people who do the right thing for a baby in tough circumstances like my birth mother, and those willing to care for the babies of this world like those who raised me.’ It was a nice reminder of what we do.”_
**-** Chanel Prunier, VP of Political Affairs - _Students for Life Action_
The only hurdle we have to clear is to generate enough resources from all our current pro-life supporters to convert enough new voters in time and turn the tables on the Abortion Lobby!

## **[Donate to _Students for Life Action's_ End of Quarter Push >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwsjt-duchtdja-d/)**
With your support, we have a chance to protect Life in these referendum states.

And as we do so, we’ll strike a blow against the Abortion Lobby that they’ll never recover from.

**[So, Pro-Life Friend, will you please click here to make your most generous contribution right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwsjt-duchtdja-h/)?**

Thank you for all you continue to do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

I was born a hillbilly in the foothills of Appalachia.

_But you and I both know the strength of our movement comes down to our numbers._ Millions of Americans elected President Trump, millions stepped up when he was convicted, and millions more will help save this country from the corrupt Liberal elites.

So here's my final pitch to you, Friend:

This will be the most expensive election in American history. By a lot. The Democrat Machine has always crushed us in fundraising. **We have the message. We have the candidates. We have the leader - and we can win it all. **

_But that takes everyone stepping up right now. Not tomorrow. Not in October. Right here and now._

Respectfully, could you spare a few bucks to help us out?

Time is of the essence so I'll wrap this up, but we really need your help. When we expand our Majority in the House, win back the Senate, and get President Trump back in the White House - I promise it'll all be worth it.

You can quote me on that.

Thanks and God bless you,
_- JD Vance_

name: Hillsdale College via Freedom Liberty Report
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT9v3iAQxj8N3rDgINgMHiI5npI0aoaOiNecXyNhgwDH6revnCadO97dc8_v_vx6MS_WB7_fX-2GwxKyycXs1qw-BArnSVMxwEBSpih0hjduYFw7KRsceMe17CVo0ayD6i3yB-0WySXXnHWdYnJZOrBK953UjR8uH6agY1oqkK3TvQW1MLhxIW63nkhmA-baLhnRxc3uLvgb5vo7Y4q5tnPcmjCstaZCxCOBicBUcD4yuvaatzgbsEV3EJj-xZfmSFc_rSvSgnPcHT1jDo6eNhcipjITMTImlX5lIOGZP4w_xqendwLqqJsp8cgzEjGmHEvCufr9_lXa0PljI2LEzfrwlZztlqy_70SMf2mfsItl3If7FsW94l6JGN_ezdsjnZ5_0u_7NHlw6fQh-KI6Itn9Mv_cvv7Phz4G-BMAAP__YSOXpw) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT9v3iAQxj8N3rDgINgMHiI5npI0aoaOiNecXyNhgwDH6revnCadO97dc8_v_vx6MS_WB7_fX-2GwxKyycXs1qw-BArnSVMxwEBSpih0hjduYFw7KRsceMe17CVo0ayD6i3yB-0WySXXnHWdYnJZOrBK953UjR8uH6agY1oqkK3TvQW1MLhxIW63nkhmA-baLhnRxc3uLvgb5vo7Y4q5tnPcmjCstaZCxCOBicBUcD4yuvaatzgbsEV3EJj-xZfmSFc_rSvSgnPcHT1jDo6eNhcipjITMTImlX5lIOGZP4w_xqendwLqqJsp8cgzEjGmHEvCufr9_lXa0PljI2LEzfrwlZztlqy_70SMf2mfsItl3If7FsW94l6JGN_ezdsjnZ5_0u_7NHlw6fQh-KI6Itn9Mv_cvv7Phz4G-BMAAP__YSOXpw)**

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/fC1Z1FV8hmXQndc_ti-Ltw~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/fC1Z1FV8hmXQndc_ti-Ltw~~/AARclAA~~~) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/fC1Z1FV8hmXQndc_ti-Ltw~~/AARclAA~~~)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/fC1Z1FV8hmXQndc_ti-Ltw~~/AARclAA~~~)**

## Trump, Biden Ready to Rumble on CNN
President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump will [face off tonight](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO5CAQRL8GZ1jQZmAcEFzibC690GqgGXNijAWsrf371Wy20malCqqe3r_H-sCU0_78iy-yPZYVfU8nrZqD4aBWNQQbiYCmgaw0clbzzcxy2CxEBCmF1-FuUMzROTeRx7vSToJCHJIFAUpoMFIIqdQY7rc5TME4L6dJxRtTgkLqpY7_S9r7RjF_lpPq6MtryHbr_Whs-sNgYbBc1zUedFVqhNVvY6lPBkvbSu28EobGYHn_MViEfmfJYNE8ou-NoysfnR-VWgq094SZ4x74mTz9bAM57PTeGqoNx5VyTk0bpsTzhSl_k_XfPZ0WvgIAAP__L75q2A) in the first of two planned debates, the earliest presidential debate in history. The rules of the debate are also new, with CNN hosting rather than the nonpartisan Commission on Presidential Debates. Tonight, the candidates have agreed that their microphones will be muted while the other man speaks, and there will be two commercial breaks. The moderators, CNN's Jake Tapper and Dana Bash, have come under fire already this week for being biased against Trump and will be [under heavy scrutiny](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUQOGngY0ILhcIA0MXb-na0cLmOqbiJ7Jpor591c6dj3SG7-M232Iuud3fY6Uwtj7HdeQnzVaAE4Az8hQ2IiDNKSinPHrjvOJ7sKC8prg5Y-UCuCowXjpjnF-0tdfEcwAJKC04JaVCvKSr8Uknt6xKa9wMQ0kpj35cPntuY6etfPcnHZe1V17CPsbjZPqNwcRgGjvtuZTfxmDae6VGr5PBVCnlyGBCh8ogirU1UXuiIw46xZITNTGOr_oQiZY4iMHEj5Aer1xKPq1jKO815r8zH_8bPAP8BAAA___GHVz6) for how they handle the debate. Roughly [60% of Americans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuO6yAUAL_G7ojgcMyjoLhNutx2S4vHIWGFjUVYR_v3q2y95WiKkebjtt58qWW___cbuZHb6uMoJ62KgWaAK87JZSIgOZMTWli0i7ZifrhAQWHKQRsrQlAiG4ncgA5JIlob5uKAA3IFWnAuEC_JLDbJpEMUUmJeJuSUymj98tnKPh6U63c7qV9i2-bqHmMcz0n-m-A6wdUfO72eb_WGPkqsNMH1aLWyUBLtbPSv7WCJgh_E_LG3HlmMloSiLFAvXAsFBBCtSikYY4nM3F06XqXW8lR6Qn7ffKm__fH3jdPBTwAAAP__WgJgdA) say they plan to watch, according to an AP/NORC survey. Presidential debates are the second-most watched televised event on TV, after the Super Bowl.
## Anti-Israel Incumbent Trounced in Primary
New York Rep. Jamaal Bowman, a fierce pro-Palestinian advocate, was [trounced in his primary](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGnwR0WDAPEBcVt3OW2W1rYjJ2JsIlsFLRvv8rW253iSJ_0f92ne-TMx_Y_7hTqWqa4VH7T5CR4CThhl8JKBGQ6CtrrAQfrB909AmJMN0_WL2BWcCaRnR2iXo2ewUbsOIACVA68Vkoj9ulmh2SSnxdtDK5WoKLEtZz9s_BRH7Tm7_Kms1_K3uXwqPV1CfNPwChgbK31r5K58lI-BwHjQe0SMH4UAaNyn20FjM-4x5jlXNoeD5nLRZfcqJwbyRwr73RKpbTDYfDdGdKrcc58OS9QbXvk_OvXv2u8A_wEAAD__4tlX0s) against moderate Democrat George Latimer in what became the most expensive House primary in history. Bowman, who gained notoriety for pulling a fire alarm to stall a House vote, was running in a district with a strong Jewish presence. Latimer, the winner, benefited from more than $14 million in ad spending by AIPAC, a leading pro-Israel lobbying group. Bowman is the first member of the so-called leftist "Squad" to lose an election since the group formed in 2018. The same forces that opposed him have now [targeted Rep. Cori Bush of Missouri,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3OozAURJ_GdEb-A0LhYlPQZduUyNjX4a6wzdombN5-ReqvmpHOFKPzfMwPgxvG128TQFefZmMrvmHuqRioULNqnPYAAmQDmg98VGM3jLxZNRu94b2V3DOv5I3dROc4X7gAaYXjrkEtmFCsFwNnjCvVuls3OumGxXIple-IYuCwptz-SRjrCn77pDfk1qbQbHqtdS9E_iJiImI6z7MNJV6MiAkiPQoRU4Tzij1tWNFeta5Ay9_DOIqF7kelKdKYKlqgxlfIdElnMPGiNacjWnA0YCnpyEgDhAVyoTEFjKZi-u6OnUb4V4mYTKb3O0_P_fVpsnb7iduGpR-IYq9gcPs-rz97fGvxPwAA____uXg5) also a "Squad" member. In Colorado, Rep. Lauren Boebert [easily won her primary](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn-NvREBBmMGhi7Z0rWjdXBHchU2FqGJ8u-rdO746Rve0_u6rBfgwvv1EzYKPdcVUucHrbPQTmizmhFDJtI0jRSUU95467wab8GmGI1eJi-VtQSKlEOFTkqMuICNIwcttZGzdkpKZcwJF-txQheTmiaT7WAkIffaTt-V936jXF71Qe2U6jaWcOv9uA_Tx6DPgz7DsdPz_r7eo3VOhQZ9TrXUBljF0XiD9hJUKHWuu3jDRawUqXXR6PiJhRPswmZlJqejtUkieFJ5cTqC9RKyndGOLeDx5FL4PrvByOsGXP6U-v-BHkH_BgAA__8UEWc-) despite switching districts and coming under fire for her behavior at a theater in Denver.
## Consumers Push Back on Prices
Major retailers and fast-food restaurants are [cutting prices and offering discounts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAQRp_GdEb-A9aFi9vQ7W1TIjMzsBMZvMJeSN4-2tTpPumTzpHOx326R068r__jRqEueYpQ-aSpl2aQxk2uwbAQGbINBT1o73w3eN08ggMCnL0Hq2fofednDXiDBaOaVY9Lw8Eo41RvBq2Udq7FW-fR4jCDttYtnXCKkGs-2s_Me33Qkr7zSUcLeWtSeNT6LML-E2YUZryuq41fnMv7FWZ8s4UZVf_eVpixxmOlKp8HA0l41SLLa9vokCWevK9FboB5jwmLRIqpOQI-L06JSz8Ip9Ytcvo11787nMH8BAAA___HrmBP) this summer to win back customers who are resisting high prices. Walmart, Target, Walgreens, Aldi, and Ikea have initiated a series of price reductions, and fast-food chains have also joined the discount bandwagon. For fast-food chains, $5 has become [the magic number](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEb2YvBRuPgbuvvblGiPXd85MvhkG0jePiJ1mk8jjTQafR_3-Y4hhu35H1d21acZlxoOngcJVoKZTUPOMwN3DTtt9WjG3o66eTnqPA1Ka-0XMKj0eLN-8X2vH5ZuI_gmOFBg1ABWK6WNaenWj9SRfSy664zvhVFMoabcfqaw1Rf7-J0Ozu2S1ia6V63vIrp_AiYB03meLX6FVK5WwHRtC5jUcOUL60Jpw0hFroxR0gUfDpaUYsRcZOZScc-4VXlg3FmuvO1NdvQ-Q4yhDFYY9VwxxN8D9W8dh4OfAAAA__90j2HI). Burger King debuted a "$5 Your Way Meal" earlier this month, and McDonald's rolled out a similar $5 value meal on Tuesday. Wendy's offers its Biggie Bag meal at $5 and a $3 breakfast deal. Despite these efforts, grocery prices remain [nearly 30% higher](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uxCAQhJ8GOixYsPcoKNK4u7QpLcLPeRPOWDaxk7ePnDrNaKSR5tP3dp_ungotj1f_TK7lOvnQ6EjTIAAFmMnw6HJKkDRPTqGyxvZoFZ9dVIi6tzevg8GbtlHliAgSM6osreLkQIKRA6CSUhnTxVtvo474HpTWJvfMyBSp1a37qLS0OeXyU4-0daE-eXFza-vO9AuDkcF4nmfnv6nu18pgvL4ZjHK4-hVfu6AlF9-oLiLUelmJdaOQxEyfaeebi-tJpdA-IDPy8fRU_lDtf_HDwW8AAAD__54-WLI) than pre-pandemic levels.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We’re suing the YMCA
body:
Have you heard the news?

| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6uqf4ucc6rrckgcm1klo9cbdks0ae0mi2i7mtm8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,Have you heard the news?We're suing the Olympic Peninsula YMCA and City of Port Townsend, Washington, on behalf of grandmother Julie Jaman.**[**Will you donate $35 or more right now to help fund this critical new lawsuit?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb4nv2em47atvquftt8k3nin077t98f58fgjfcco_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)** **** If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?After all, the YMCA was founded to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit. But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough _enough_ , friend?The answer is **now.** Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day **she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room.** The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. **Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave.** Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community.**[**Now you can see why I'm asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to help fund Julie's case.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7f64oov5moj2rs6mb4b6omkb676unnv5j97ta30_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the _Center for American Liberty_ – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. The way the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous – it's unconstitutional.The City of Port Townsend owns the pool and contracts with the YMCA to operate it. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. Here at the _Center for American Liberty_ , our unique strategy is taking down the Left in the courts. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. We are honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. That's why our attorneys filed a lawsuit to protect Julie's constitutional rights – and yours, friend. Winning this case means preserving your rights to free speech and due process. Losing it means... well, that's just not an option.Because we're also talking about the safety and privacy of women and girls across America! **[**So can I count on you to donate $35 or more today to fund Julie's case and protect your own constitutional rights?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8j41uhfp4m1irljkldlf94k2dsnlcam252uitd8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)** My team and I will never stay silent as the left attacks our most basic freedoms. We also never shy away from a fight.Going head-to-head with giant liberal groups like the ACLU doesn't scare me. But it does mean we need to have the resources on hand for a dogfight. **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zujs5iib9tv9afo12jakuf5ucababjgo7j8qdr1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)** Thank you for helping us fight back against the radical left and its disgusting attacks on our children, our freedoms, and our constitutional rights.
---
| | God Bless,
---
| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9mfb8hg7kqtqbmv1d0v402iucn815tc2en27obo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon, CEOCenter for American Liberty
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4dd5hvsear3k88dv63iaobohl3et4e7ddqrthto_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)
---
| | P.S. Friend, what would you do if you saw a fully-grown man – wearing a female bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room? I'm willing to bet you'd do the exact same thing our client, Julie Jaman, did. _Confront him to protect the little girls._ **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more to help us fund this new lawsuit.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsakbas5vb090gpcipbuni9tucksavdocvj4j6q0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg64oj4cph2bs)** Because we aren't just protecting Julie's constitutional rights – we're protecting yours, too – and the privacy and safety of women and girls across America. Thank you in advance for your support!

subject: We’re suing the YMCA
body:

| | Dear Friend,Have you heard the news?We're suing the Olympic Peninsula YMCA and City of Port Townsend, Washington, on behalf of grandmother Julie Jaman.**[**Will you donate $35 or more right now to help fund this critical new lawsuit?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvakj6638kaaveucd1ndni0fg5f8uvb0htp8oefg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg6cp36c1h2bs)** **** If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?After all, the YMCA was founded to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit. But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough _enough_ , friend?The answer is **now.** Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day **she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room.** The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. **Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave.** Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community.**[**Now you can see why I'm asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to help fund Julie's case.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztljh6v0kke7o3llqitil2uam4tqnb0o09bgr748_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg6cp36c1h2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the _Center for American Liberty_ – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. The way the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous – it's unconstitutional.The City of Port Townsend owns the pool and contracts with the YMCA to operate it. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. Here at the _Center for American Liberty_ , our unique strategy is taking down the Left in the courts. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. We are honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. That's why our attorneys filed a lawsuit to protect Julie's constitutional rights – and yours, friend. Winning this case means preserving your rights to free speech and due process. Losing it means... well, that's just not an option.Because we're also talking about the safety and privacy of women and girls across America! **[**So can I count on you to donate $35 or more today to fund Julie's case and protect your own constitutional rights?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z741s1scibo4mbtkegsol3if93a32icelc3tssog_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg6cp36c1h2bs)** My team and I will never stay silent as the left attacks our most basic freedoms. We also never shy away from a fight.Going head-to-head with giant liberal groups like the ACLU doesn't scare me. But it does mean we need to have the resources on hand for a dogfight. **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt0sj54ll4t4qp39ppsa0dk5nq0kpmhg9mijdgr8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg6cp36c1h2bs)** Thank you for helping us fight back against the radical left and its disgusting attacks on our children, our freedoms, and our constitutional rights.
---
| | God Bless,
---

Harmeet K. Dhillon, CEOCenter for American Liberty

| | P.S. Friend, what would you do if you saw a fully-grown man – wearing a female bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room? I'm willing to bet you'd do the exact same thing our client, Julie Jaman, did. _Confront him to protect the little girls._ **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more to help us fund this new lawsuit.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvha4ritmcg3debs4tc0hdpqcvdq4omdfv6uot70_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg6cp36c1h2bs)** Because we aren't just protecting Julie's constitutional rights – we're protecting yours, too – and the privacy and safety of women and girls across America. Thank you in advance for your support!

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We’re suing the YMCA
body:
Have you heard the news?

| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5boank54jtpnuuks90gap2t493h0lkh11g68uhg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,Have you heard the news?We're suing the Olympic Peninsula YMCA and City of Port Townsend, Washington, on behalf of grandmother Julie Jaman.**[**Will you donate $35 or more right now to help fund this critical new lawsuit?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6dbq100nidml1fikcuf3abeef1p2ub7ftmt56ng_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)** **** If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?After all, the YMCA was founded to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit. But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough _enough_ , friend?The answer is **now.** Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day **she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room.** The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. **Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave.** Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community.**[**Now you can see why I'm asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to help fund Julie's case.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjldmcg1tku9stb947u9hp264837s17a23unjgig_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the _Center for American Liberty_ – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. The way the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous – it's unconstitutional.The City of Port Townsend owns the pool and contracts with the YMCA to operate it. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. Here at the _Center for American Liberty_ , our unique strategy is taking down the Left in the courts. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. We are honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. That's why our attorneys filed a lawsuit to protect Julie's constitutional rights – and yours, friend. Winning this case means preserving your rights to free speech and due process. Losing it means... well, that's just not an option.Because we're also talking about the safety and privacy of women and girls across America! **[**So can I count on you to donate $35 or more today to fund Julie's case and protect your own constitutional rights?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zk3v9qp2da6ep775a7gs3kvbaobqlhaitkgcm8p0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)** My team and I will never stay silent as the left attacks our most basic freedoms. We also never shy away from a fight.Going head-to-head with giant liberal groups like the ACLU doesn't scare me. But it does mean we need to have the resources on hand for a dogfight. **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more today.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zegkivdf86jt2h7u5iaiom04vtugkesppd869lto_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)** Thank you for helping us fight back against the radical left and its disgusting attacks on our children, our freedoms, and our constitutional rights.
---
| | God Bless,
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjq5d6fagggqs1hgve31qrdf3vatfveo1hrn1fp0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon, CEOCenter for American Liberty
---
| [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zcqhjamism9srirv1mtqb7g7r2192drqstgm7j7o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)
---
| | P.S. Friend, what would you do if you saw a fully-grown man – wearing a female bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room? I'm willing to bet you'd do the exact same thing our client, Julie Jaman, did. _Confront him to protect the little girls._ **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more to help us fund this new lawsuit.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5498j8m94ie542iipo2sgnqab5pm31f2iq5rke0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slg62o31cph2bs)** Because we aren't just protecting Julie's constitutional rights – we're protecting yours, too – and the privacy and safety of women and girls across America. Thank you in advance for your support!

clean_body: Have you heard the news? | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friend,Have you heard the news?We're suing the Olympic Peninsula YMCA and City of Port Townsend, Washington, on behalf of grandmother Julie Jaman. ** If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?After all, the YMCA was founded to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit. But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough enough , friend?The answer is now. Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room. The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave. Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community. My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the Center for American Liberty – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. The way the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous – it's unconstitutional.The City of Port Townsend owns the pool and contracts with the YMCA to operate it. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. Here at the Center for American Liberty , our unique strategy is taking down the Left in the courts. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. We are honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. That's why our attorneys filed a lawsuit to protect Julie's constitutional rights – and yours, friend. Winning this case means preserving your rights to free speech and due process. Losing it means... well, that's just not an option.Because we're also talking about the safety and privacy of women and girls across America! My team and I will never stay silent as the left attacks our most basic freedoms. We also never shy away from a fight.Going head-to-head with giant liberal groups like the ACLU doesn't scare me. body:
I am excited to be attending the RNC Summer Meeting and the 2024 Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, WI!
| | | |
---
Friend, We are 10 days away from the Republican National Convention and the 2024 Summer Meeting of the RNC.
As a member of the RNC's Youth Advisory Council, I will be wheels up for Milwaukee in just 9 days, where I will spend over half of July attending the Summer Meeting and National Convention.
It is the highest honor of my life to represent my generation on the national level in an effort to ensure we keep Gen Z conservative.
Spending two full weeks in Milwaukee, especially during convention week, is a heavy burden. I have been saving up my money all year in preparation for this event. I even sold some pretty cool t-shirts, but I am still going to come up short.
Times are tough, inflation is rampant, crime is skyrocketing, and our nation is turning into a banana republic. That is why I am traveling to Milwaukee: to ensure that our party is stronger than ever going into November and that we elect President Trump for four more years in the White House!
If you are able and willing, I would greatly appreciate a contribution to my RNC Travel Fund. Thanks to your generous support, I have been able to attend the RNC meetings in 2023 and now 2024, as well as council meetings in Washington DC at RNC HQ.

Peter,
North Carolina has been a haven for brazen gerrymandering for a LONG time. While we have a long way to go in the Tar Heel State, today we are celebrating the one-year anniversary of a landmark victory: the Supreme Court’s ruling in _Moore v. Harper_.
Some quick backstory: One of our affiliates, the National Redistricting Foundation, had mounted a successful challenge to the state’s gerrymandered congressional map.
But anti-democratic radicals tried to reverse that ruling based on the fringe “independent state legislature” theory. Our affiliate supported voters who fought back all the way to the Supreme Court and won: preserving checks and balances by making sure state legislatures would not have sole authority to draw maps.
**The fair maps movement prevented a five-alarm fire for our democracy and AOTL was there to build on this, but map manipulators are still using every possible avenue to try to cling to unearned power. So we have to keep up the fight.**

clean_body: It’s tough right now, but we can do it. | Peter, North Carolina has been a haven for brazen gerrymandering for a LONG time. While we have a long way to go in the Tar Heel State, today we are celebrating the one-year anniversary of a landmark victory: the Supreme Court’s ruling in Moore v. Harper. Some quick backstory: One of our affiliates, the National Redistricting Foundation, had mounted a successful challenge to the state’s gerrymandered congressional map. But anti-democratic radicals tried to reverse that ruling based on the fringe “independent state legislature” theory. Our affiliate supported voters who fought back all the way to the Supreme Court and won: preserving checks and balances by making sure state legislatures would not have sole authority to draw maps. The fair maps movement prevented a five-alarm fire for our democracy and AOTL was there to build on this, but map manipulators are still using every possible avenue to try to cling to unearned power. So we have to keep up the fight. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = While we reflect on this victory, we also resolve to keep fighting back after tough losses, like the Supreme Court’s recent ruling making it even harder for plaintiffs to stop racial gerrymandering. **But we need to remember that when we get organized and stay in the fight, we can achieve significant victories. This movement came together to secure a win for democracy in Moore v. I hope this letter finds you well. We, the Green Beret PAC, have a significant and time-sensitive mission that we ask you to support.
One of the greatest misconceptions in American history is that the battle for our freedom was won with the end of the Revolutionary War. The battle for our freedom never ends. Historians state that of all the colonists affected by the increasing tyranny of English rule, only 12% joined the fight. 12% risked and pledged everything, while the other 88% lived to reap the benefit.
In 2024, we can't count on a 12% effort from this nation's people. We're up against one of the most influential and organized examples of anti-American machines witnessed in generations. They have involved themselves in both parties and at the highest levels of government and commerce. They're financed, organized, and entrenched. Lesser nations have crumbled to their tactics. But we are stronger.
This outreach requests the funds to put more Green Berets and other principled veterans into public office. These are strong, determined patriots loyal to the Constitution, soldiers who won't sell out, sit back, or come up short. They are a Congress of Patriots who, like the Green Beret and all trusted veterans, are always on the rescue.
That's the situation in brief--no long letter. We have to mount up, and timing is essential.
Your contribution will purchase media advertising, consulting, research, staffing, signage, and the technology required to ensure an effective effort in electing a new brand of citizen soldiers and dedicated public servants with a mission that will benefit all Americans. With the White House likely returning to citizen control in January, the new administration - and the American people - will need support on the ground from as many conservative, patriotic legislators as possible.
Our enemy is embedded in our government and the permanent D. C. bureaucracy. It will take an army of us to retake our sacred ground and return our nation to its rightful glory.
Join our Mission to Elect Green Berets and other Principled Veterans to Congress!
Now, more than ever, we require individuals who have demonstrated their commitment to service and can be relied upon to uphold and defend our conservative principles.
Help Green Beret PAC serve as a force multiplier to these crucial campaigns and secure victories for our veterans nationwide.
