Thursday, June 27, 2024 | Peter -- Today, we're bringing you a special edition of our weekly Fast Forward newsletter because we've been seeing momentum building across the country!
### Massachusetts Forward Party
On June 20th, the Massachusetts Forward Party filed the paperwork to become an official political designation in the state, allowing voters to denote that they belong to the Forward Party on their voter registration and candidates to run as members of the Party. Massachusetts is a state that _needs_ the Forward Party. "Massachusetts is broken," said Forward Executive Director Kerry Healey, who served as Lieutenant Governor of Massachusetts under Mitt Romney. "More than 60% of Massachusetts' registered voters chose not to affiliate as either Republicans or Democrats, and the Massachusetts GOP claims only 8% of registered voters." [Read more about the MA Forward Party launch here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=QbF-A43IZlAkjFqaumBqPbiS6YSNh09wcVpiX76m49LaCv6aYKBqHR1RfJ9Bej7s3PEPDFxIDWp8Rc7LpdEtWwW4bG_j6lujSkvHL5E1xguT640pnzEDca_cVuBHrqBz55aryNTXd3fq1vPY0i4mUz25L2FzY6S4nN9KRclNnCY&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_edition_forward_s_re&n=2). _LG Healey and MA Forward Party leadership on the steps of the State House just before filing their official paperwork._
### Forward Gains a Republican Affiliate in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, Making for Bipartisan Representation
On June 24th, the [Forward Party endorsed Pennsylvania State Representative Valerie Gaydos](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wJe7Oi2KXzCNE6T3sSKybawz_lfTKbLwknrwqOhoCWHgGYWzNZaXONp0wlNheBFeC9LxT2gRC1w0OvMTjALpjW4eV7Sw-Yp_isttl8hhbZVNZGqOYsl5JEgHD51uRUIJ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_edition_forward_s_re&n=3) (R-Moon Township) at a press conference in Leetsdale. State Rep. Gaydos has held her seat since 2018 and has lived up to the values of the Forward Party. State Rep. Gaydos cites part of the reason she accepted the Forward Party's endorsement is that the party is willing to work with Democrats and Republicans alike, alongside independents and reformers, to help "combat extremism and to work for the people". She joins a large and growing list of PA Forwardists from both parties and both houses of the state legislature, including Senators Tony Williams and Lisa Boscola!
### Forward Candidates Win Big on Tuesday Night!
Two Forward endorsed candidates won their primaries on Tuesday. They'll both advance to the general election in November. [John Avlon (NY-01)](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wWw1LGKe09YoyrHaTkDQ4GG1qh98GYcXj0zaOWKzAET8rF-zh1Sz-4ns48surSO0D_s5ENcDKDsqK69DLT3fOcTuSbmGcw6xyQHKLSgU-57sq7oUYcchGXxFv4vJbd7i3rXceNTIoTqe6Tu9idH_vw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_edition_forward_s_re&n=4) will take on MAGA Rep. Nick LaLota in the fall, and [John Curtis (Utah Senate)](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=dVV2rW1vUlrpxgYY_oyMKqEWok2YsbwUgLPE_bgETDPXaYbMpPYdoeBASHtmQLo8A8DXb1dXPINw2icwi7OVk9UBzLMAL6m78DWFKuZnFza-VL5qNQSsuKh-JDw_Ex1l&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_edition_forward_s_re&n=5) beat back an extremist challenger in the primary and has his sights set on November now.
### South Carolina Forward Party Announces a Slate of Endorsed Candidates from Across the Political Spectrum
The South Carolina Forward Party has been hard at work finding good candidates to represent the real needs of everyday Americans. People who won't fight for their party and the special interests they represent, but instead will fight for their constituents. Meet these candidates below!
### Independent Veterans of America Launches. You're Invited to an Exclusive Pre-Debate Zoom!
Independent Veterans of America is launching tomorrow night with an important mission: To organize the millions of politically independent and unaffiliated veterans in America into a powerful force for good - and get them elected. They're here to fight for the soul of the country that we all love, to defend our American values, and to improve our nation for all the generations to come. They want veterans who aren't beholden to the Democrats and Republicans, who hold country above party, and who are ready to do the hard work of getting our country back on track. They've extended a special offer to the Forward Party to come to the launch event - let's turn out for this great cause! | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=AqY7VoEUzHlAVH9yJtSeP45Lal_LAywt-sr9B_0MC8ug3a8r70Odvt4WR9nD12Q7nRAAA0SIcbEoc7wp_3XqPg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_edition_forward_s_re&n=6 "Join The Pack") [Join The Pack](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=AqY7VoEUzHlAVH9yJtSeP45Lal_LAywt-sr9B_0MC8ug3a8r70Odvt4WR9nD12Q7nRAAA0SIcbEoc7wp_3XqPg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_edition_forward_s_re&n=6)

name: Nichole Johnson [Campaign Manager, Gallego for Arizona]
subject: We’re starting to get worried
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Every day we have to make decisions maximizing the resources we have at our disposal. In a race like this one, as competitive as this one, those resources are always limited. Lately, those decisions have been more difficult than ever.
#

Peter — things aren’t looking good.
Every day we have to make decisions maximizing the resources we have at our disposal. In a race like this one, as competitive as this one, those resources are always limited. Lately, those decisions have been more difficult than ever.
The long and short of it is this:
Kari Lake leads Ruben in an internal poll leaked by the NRSC, and we know they wouldn’t leak that information if they didn’t think it was strong.
The NRSC also just announced a $100 million advertising blitz across four states, with Arizona squarely in their crosshairs. That’s alongside millions in commitments from Kari Lake’s own campaign. They don’t make reservations like that unless they know there’s a real opportunity.
And right as we’re ramping up our own spending, right as the odds are stacking up against us, our own fundraising is falling off. With just a few days until an official FEC reporting deadline, we’re not tracking to our goal.
We’re stretched thin as it is, and if this keeps up we’re not going to have what we need to fight back. I won’t lie to you, Peter. We’re starting to get worried.
I’m writing to you today because you are the only way we can turn this around. This team hasn’t let us down yet — and I’m hoping that’s still the case.

Never before in United States history has a Presidential race featured an incumbent with a 36% approval rating facing a challenger with 34 felony convictions, and three more criminal trials on deck. And tonight, they debate. Here's what to expect.

---|---|---
Donald Trump and Joe Biden. Credit: AP
Tonight's debate, the first of two, will cover an array of topics from two men reviving their 2020 race. In my analysis I share the topics I believe CNN moderators Jake Tapper and Dana Bash will cover and who will emerge victorious on that topic, what jabs each candidate will take against the other, and what glaring absences will remain to the detriment of the American people.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..QvNSnj3qHosGZVRw1Jw7B4-1BVIvgSzaFjG3Q_Q8vwI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146031783)
# The Topics
**Abortion**
Donald Trump continues to brag that he's the reason why Roe was overturned. Indeed, he appointed three of the right wing justices who voted to undo a half century of precedent (after promising not to do so during their confirmation hearings). President Biden will continue to commit to protecting reproductive health access and will promise that when reelected, he will work to codify abortion into law. More than 72% of Americans support comprehensive abortion access and every time abortion has been on the ballot, it has won. Trump is in trouble on this one.
* _**Winner: Biden**_

**Immigration**
Polling shows that on immigration, [more Americans trust Donald Trump than they do Joe Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/58cf24f7-6ae0-460f-aaee-1d2157d476e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Perhaps this is because while President Biden ran on condemning Donald Trump's asylum restrictions and deportation policies, he's since largely adopted those same policies in his own administration. These aren't my words, [it's what the ACLU said in explaining why they're suing Joe Biden for his new immigration policies](https://substack.com/redirect/8b2cd43c-53d7-4a72-b0bb-172a44433f31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Donald Trump's immigration policies are mortifying. But if Donald Trump is smart, he will win points by reminding voters that even Joe Biden agrees with him.
* _**Winner: Trump**_

**Economy/Inflation**
Despite polling showing that [more Americans trust Trump than trust Biden on the economy](https://substack.com/redirect/0404b6ac-8deb-433d-a2d0-fba96b27ac95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Biden has a lot to run on. He can remind voters that Trump was the first President since Herbert Hoover who left office with fewer jobs than when they came in. He can remind voters that inflation is now a more modest 3.3% and his administration is going after the corporate bad actors exploiting consumers. He can remind voters that his time in office has overseen 15 million new jobs, more than any President in history. He can remind voters of his landmark infrastructure bill, the CHIPS Act, and the COVID relief bills, all things that Trump failed to do. The question is whether Americans will believe Biden's facts or Trump's tantrums?
* _**Winner: Tossup**_

**Election Integrity**
To this day Donald Trump publicly claims the 2020 election was stolen from him. Notwithstanding him privately admitting he's lost (on tape), or the fact that every single court that heard his arguments ruled against him, or the fact that every lawyer who argued those cases has plead guilty to pushing the Big Lie--notwithstanding all that--Trump continues to push the Big Lie himself. President Biden will lean into the importance of a democracy, not a dictatorship, and will win independents and moderates in addition to his base.
* _**Winner: Biden**_

**Palestine and Israel**
Both candidates will use this question to show how committed they are to Israel, period. Neither will show much empathy for the 39,000 Palestinians killed and the nearly 2 million Palestinians displaced. Neither will mention Israel's war crimes, Israel's refusal to accept the binding UN Security Council resolution for complete ceasefire and release of all hostages, or Israel's plan to annex the West Bank. Trump will cite his Abraham Accords and Biden will cite that his administration has sent more than $6.5B in military aid to Israel since October 7. Trump will undoubtedly say something antisemitic but his base won't care because they never have before and they aren't about to start now.
* _**Winner: Netanyahu**_

# **The Jabs**
**Joe Biden:** Biden will remind voters that Trump is a 34 times convicted felon, that he has three more criminal trials pending, but most of all, that even his own former Vice President and the majority of his former cabinet do not support him.
**Donald Trump:** Trump will claim to voters that Biden is behind his allegedly political prosecution, that Biden is somehow responsible for his grown son Hunter's felony convictions, and that Biden is old.
I don't believe either jab will flip voters, but will largely serve to reinforce each side's voter base and win emotional validation points that their respective candidate is a fighter.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..QvNSnj3qHosGZVRw1Jw7B4-1BVIvgSzaFjG3Q_Q8vwI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146031783)
# **The Glaring Absences**
**Universal Healthcare:** While I believe the moderators will bring up healthcare, neither candidate will commit to universal healthcare as a human right. This, even though studies show that a guaranteed universal healthcare model will save Americans [$450B annually while preventing 68,000 annual deaths](https://substack.com/redirect/5d9eefd0-bf7c-497d-8607-05d3c48d90b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Sadly, Big Healthcare money in politics is too strong to let that happen.
**Money in Politics:** Speaking of money, neither candidate will discuss meaningful reform of our broken political system--one in which dark money PACs and foreign government lobbyists can spend tens of millions of dollars to thwart the will of the American people. Despite more than 90% of Americans demanding an end to corporate money in politics, this will be an ignored topic.
**Israeli War Crimes:** Undoubtedly the topic of Palestine and Israel will come up. Undoubtedly Hamas will be condemned. Undoubtedly Trump will use it as an additional opportunity to tout his xenophobic and ineffective Muslim ban. But there will be no discussion of how [the International Court of Justice, the International Criminal Court, the United Nations, and the US State Department all agree in full or at least in part that Israel has violated international law, is committing war crimes, is exterminating Palestinians, and is committing genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/7c567735-1a81-464f-b337-07e190673a85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Instead, Trump might criticize Biden for not embracing Netanyahu or personally inviting him to address Congress.
**Housing Exploitation** : Zillow recently reported that the average American needs to [earn 80% more now than just 4 years ago to afford the same size house](https://substack.com/redirect/95355253-b86c-48c8-92fc-21915f4b72e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Private equity corporations are buying up houses by the masses, buying off politicians to look the other way, and the American people are suffering. We need meaningful housing reform, and sadly, neither candidate will discuss this topic during the debate.
**Racial and Social Injustice:** Whether its the repeal of Affirmative Action, the hundreds of proposed and passed laws banning DEI, CRT, and books by Black, minority, and LGBTQ authors, or anti-Trans legislation, it seems unlikely that this debate will cover these issues in any meaningful way.
**Climate Change:** Biden has made major investments in combatting climate change (while also making major anti-climate decisions on fossil fuels) and Trump is a climate denier. That said, I'd be surprised to see a thorough debate beyond a passing mention.
**Gun Violence:** As important as this topic is, I'd be surprised to see a thorough debate beyond a passing mention.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..QvNSnj3qHosGZVRw1Jw7B4-1BVIvgSzaFjG3Q_Q8vwI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146031783)
**In Conclusion**
I'm hopeful that my assumptions about the glaring absences are all wrong, and the debate exemplifies a robust dialogue about them. My overall assessment is that Joe Biden will win this debate if he sticks to facts, stays on the attack, and owns up to his shortcomings and failures. Given that the next debate is not until September, and given that most polls have Biden and Trump within the margin of error of each other, a Biden loss or underperformance could be extremely harmful for his overall campaign.

When the time is right, I hope you'll consider upgrading to a $5/mo or $50/year subscription! Biden vs Trump. The topics, the jabs, and the glaring absences. | | | Jun 27 | | | | | | | | | | | | Never before in United States history has a Presidential race featured an incumbent with a 36% approval rating facing a challenger with 34 felony convictions, and three more criminal trials on deck. And tonight, they debate. Here's what to expect. | | ---|---|--- Donald Trump and Joe Biden. Credit: AP Tonight's debate, the first of two, will cover an array of topics from two men reviving their 2020 race. In my analysis I share the topics I believe CNN moderators Jake Tapper and Dana Bash will cover and who will emerge victorious on that topic, what jabs each candidate will take against the other, and what glaring absences will remain to the detriment of the American people. The Topics Abortion Donald Trump continues to brag that he's the reason why Roe was overturned. Indeed, he appointed three of the right wing justices who voted to undo a half century of precedent (after promising not to do so during their confirmation hearings). President Biden will continue to commit to protecting reproductive health access and will promise that when reelected, he will work to codify abortion into law. More than 72% of Americans support comprehensive abortion access and every time abortion has been on the ballot, it has won. Trump is in trouble on this one. Winner: Biden Immigration Polling shows that on immigration, . Perhaps this is because while President Biden ran on condemning Donald Trump's asylum restrictions and deportation policies, he's since largely adopted those same policies in his own administration. These aren't my words, . Donald Trump's immigration policies are mortifying. But if Donald Trump is smart, he will win points by reminding voters that even Joe Biden agrees with him. Winner: Trump Economy/Inflation Despite polling showing that , Biden has a lot to run on. He can remind voters that Trump was the first President since Herbert Hoover who left office with fewer jobs than when they came in. He can remind voters that inflation is now a more modest 3.3% and his administration is going after the corporate bad actors exploiting consumers. He can remind voters that his time in office has overseen 15 million new jobs, more than any President in history. He can remind voters of his landmark infrastructure bill, the CHIPS Act, and the COVID relief bills, all things that Trump failed to do. The question is whether Americans will believe Biden's facts or Trump's tantrums? Winner: Tossup Election Integrity To this day Donald Trump publicly claims the 2020 election was stolen from him. Notwithstanding him privately admitting he's lost (on tape), or the fact that every single court that heard his arguments ruled against him, or the fact that every lawyer who argued those cases has plead guilty to pushing the Big Lie--notwithstanding all that--Trump continues to push the Big Lie himself. President Biden will lean into the importance of a democracy, not a dictatorship, and will win independents and moderates in addition to his base. Winner: Biden Palestine and Israel Both candidates will use this question to show how committed they are to Israel, period. Neither will show much empathy for the 39,000 Palestinians killed and the nearly 2 million Palestinians displaced. Neither will mention Israel's war crimes, Israel's refusal to accept the binding UN Security Council resolution for complete ceasefire and release of all hostages, or Israel's plan to annex the West Bank. Trump will cite his Abraham Accords and Biden will cite that his administration has sent more than $6.5B in military aid to Israel since October 7. Trump will undoubtedly say something antisemitic but his base won't care because they never have before and they aren't about to start now. Winner: Netanyahu The Jabs Joe Biden: Biden will remind voters that Trump is a 34 times convicted felon, that he has three more criminal trials pending, but most of all, that even his own former Vice President and the majority of his former cabinet do not support him. Donald Trump: Trump will claim to voters that Biden is behind his allegedly political prosecution, that Biden is somehow responsible for his grown son Hunter's felony convictions, and that Biden is old. I don't believe either jab will flip voters, but will largely serve to reinforce each side's voter base and win emotional validation points that their respective candidate is a fighter. The Glaring Absences Universal Healthcare: While I believe the moderators will bring up healthcare, neither candidate will commit to universal healthcare as a human right. This, even though studies show that a guaranteed universal healthcare model will save Americans . Sadly, Big Healthcare money in politics is too strong to let that happen. Money in Politics: Speaking of money, neither candidate will discuss meaningful reform of our broken political system--one in which dark money PACs and foreign government lobbyists can spend tens of millions of dollars to thwart the will of the American people. Despite more than 90% of Americans demanding an end to corporate money in politics, this will be an ignored topic. Israeli War Crimes: Undoubtedly the topic of Palestine and Israel will come up. Undoubtedly Hamas will be condemned. Undoubtedly Trump will use it as an additional opportunity to tout his xenophobic and ineffective Muslim ban. But there will be no discussion of how . Instead, Trump might criticize Biden for not embracing Netanyahu or personally inviting him to address Congress. Housing Exploitation : Zillow recently reported that the average American needs to . Private equity corporations are buying up houses by the masses, buying off politicians to look the other way, and the American people are suffering. We need meaningful housing reform, and sadly, neither candidate will discuss this topic during the debate. Racial and Social Injustice: Whether its the repeal of Affirmative Action, the hundreds of proposed and passed laws banning DEI, CRT, and books by Black, minority, and LGBTQ authors, or anti-Trans legislation, it seems unlikely that this debate will cover these issues in any meaningful way. Climate Change: Biden has made major investments in combatting climate change (while also making major anti-climate decisions on fossil fuels) and Trump is a climate denier. That said, I'd be surprised to see a thorough debate beyond a passing mention. Gun Violence: As important as this topic is, I'd be surprised to see a thorough debate beyond a passing mention. In Conclusion I'm hopeful that my assumptions about the glaring absences are all wrong, and the debate exemplifies a robust dialogue about them. My overall assessment is that Joe Biden will win this debate if he sticks to facts, stays on the attack, and owns up to his shortcomings and failures. Given that the next debate is not until September, and given that most polls have Biden and Trump within the margin of error of each other, a Biden loss or underperformance could be extremely harmful for his overall campaign. | | POLL Who do you think will win tonight's Presidential Debate? | ? ? name: Tom Fitton
subject: FOIA Under Attack by the Biden Administration!
body:
The politicized Biden Department of Justice has sunk to a new low... ..they have asked a federal court to allow them to rewrite the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) to protect Joe Biden by withholding audio recordings from Judicial Watch

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

**The politicized Biden Department of Justice has sunk to a new low...**
**..._they have asked a federal court to allow them to rewrite the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)_ to protect Joe Biden by withholding audio recordings from Judicial Watch of the president's interviews in Special Counsel Hur's criminal investigation of Biden's theft and disclosure of classified records! **
But [we are fighting back](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68864&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68864&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

We filed our first FOIA lawsuit seeking the release of these audio recordings back in March.

We believe the American people have every right to hear the president explain to investigators how and why he removed classified vice presidential records from the White House in 2017 and stored them in unsecured locations...

..._an offense for which he received a slap on the wrist, but for which the same Justice Department raided Donald Trump's Florida home, indicted him, and is now preparing to try him in federal court_!

Our lawsuit has already made a huge impact..._it forced the Biden administration to confess that the transcripts they released of the audio recordings have been altered and are not accurate_.

_But we are not done yet_...and that's why **[I urge you to support us with a special contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68864&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68864&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Last week we asked a federal court to reject this politically-driven effort to rewrite FOIA and not let the American people make their own judgment about President Biden's defense of his actions and his fitness for office.

We are digging in, and we will fight to defend FOIA and the American people's "right to know" for as long as we have to...

...but protracted lawsuits against the federal government come with [very real costs attached](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68864&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68864&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Every day Judicial Watch is doing the vital work of using the legal system and the courts to force the release of public records that the American people have a right to see..._and hear_!

body:
As we await the lies and attacks that will fly out of Donald Trump’s mouth tonight, here’s a look at his track record on gun safety:
#

Friend, tonight is the first presidential debate of this election season.
As we await the lies and attacks that will fly out of Donald Trump’s mouth, here’s a look at his track record on gun safety:
* ❌ When Trump was president, gun homicides increased by 34 percent.

* ❌ 36 hours after the murder of an Iowa 6th grader, Trump told Iowans they “have to get over it.”

* ❌ This year, Trump bragged at an NRA event that his administration “did nothing” when it comes to gun safety.

* ❌ Trump has promised that if he becomes president again, he’ll “terminate” all the work President Biden has done to save lives from gun violence.

* ❌ Trump blames shootings on mental health, but repeatedly tried to slash mental health coverage during his presidency.

Let’s compare that to President Biden’s record:
* ✅ President Biden signed the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ into law, the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years.

* ✅ Biden’s ATF expanded background checks, addressing dangerous loopholes and ensuring that firearms do not fall into the wrong hands.

* ✅ Biden established the nation’s first ever White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention.

* ✅ Biden has always stood up for survivors and pledged to take on the NRA.

The contrast between Trump and Biden couldn’t be clearer. While we can’t predict what exactly Donald Trump is going to say tonight, there’s one thing that’s certain:
**If we let Donald Trump back into the White House, he will roll back all of the progress we’ve made in the movement for gun safety under President Biden’s leadership.**
[**We can’t let this happen. So please, will you make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us in our work to reelect President Joe Biden and keep Donald Trump OUT of the Oval Office?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240627-1-30&t=1&akid=8390%2E3935704%2EBzQMEP)

body:
Just wanted to say hello.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T01a2dbfb-9695-4c0b-861a-721a4c9b3aaf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
|
---
| | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T220cefde-ca3a-4f07-b6c3-1b2902358c33/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Hi Peter, My name is Josh Harder - I’m a husband, a new dad, and the Democratic Congressman from California’s 9th district, one of the most competitive races in the country. ☝️That’s me with my wife Pam and our daughter Lillian - we also recently welcomed our baby girl Karina to the family! I want to reach out to introduce myself today and tell you a bit about why my race in California is a must win if we’re going to take back the House from MAGA extremists and hold the line against Donald Trump. [If you can split a donation between me and Blue Amp Action to help us win this competitive 2024 race, I’ll leave a link here.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T084b492b-85f5-4eb2-830d-d2b46d20a717/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Here’s why you should care:
1. I represent a seat in California’s Central Valley which has been named one of the most competitive in the country. Democrats recently added me to their Frontline list of most vulnerable members because we desperately need more resources to keep this seat blue.

2. I’m one of Donald Trump and Mike Johnson’s top targets this year. They’ve announced $2 million in TV reservations in our media market, and GOP SuperPACs are already spreading disinformation to our latino communities.

3. My opponent this year has been called the GOP’s “Dream Candidate” to run against me. He’s the Mayor of Stockton, the biggest city in the district, and he’s on the record saying he’ll vote against women’s reproductive rights.

4. A terrifying new poll shows us down by 4 points. If that’s the case, there is no way Democrats will take back the Speaker’s gavel. We have to make sure these aren’t the results we see on Election Day.

5. The end-of-quarter deadline is coming up and we need your help to have a strong showing. We can’t afford to be outraised by our Republican opponent, who is getting a huge boost from Trump’s guilty verdict.

[That’s why I’m reaching out today to ask for your support. I don’t take corporate PAC money, so I really need your help. Will you please split a donation between me and Blue Amp Action so we have the resources to win CA-9? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf710b551-446d-4653-afae-cafc3433faa8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1584%2E135344%2EAwH5bx)

Friend --
Like many of you, I will be watching tonight's debate between Joe Biden and Donald Trump.
I am hopeful that they will use the time to address many of the very real issues impacting Michiganders and all Americans in this election. Having watched President Trump debate several times before, I am concerned it will devolve into petty attacks and name-calling from the former president. That would be unfortunate; the American people deserve better, and our kids will be watching and hearing about this debate to be the next president.
But the truth is, I don't have to see any more from Donald Trump to know that he is unfit to lead our nation as president and as Commander in Chief again.
His anti-worker policies threaten to hurt Michiganders and the middle class. He and his judicial appointments would set the reproductive rights of women and families across this country back even further. His environmental policies and threats to roll back any progress made over the last several years threaten the habitability of our country and our planet. And as someone who barricaded herself in her office on January 6th, when he incited violence and insurrection, his attacks on our democracy should be disqualifying.
For better or worse, the outcome of the presidential election and my election are tied together. The better Trump does, the worse it is for our Senate campaign. The better we do, the more we ensure that Trump does not win Michigan -- and, by extension, the White House.
And at the end of the day, both control of the White House and the Senate run through Michigan.
So if you are anxiously awaiting tonight's debate and looking to do something that will make a difference, here's my ask:
[**Make a contribution to my campaign for Senate in Michigan. We will use your donation to help turn out the voters I need to win this race, and the voters who will defeat Donald Trump this November.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240627-1-400&t=2&akid=1584%2E135344%2EAwH5bx)

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. On the battlefield, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. clean_body: On June 4th, Montana Republicans gave me their stamp of approval in nominating me as their chosen candidate to take on radical leftist Jon Tester | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dream. My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. With the most recently released poll indicating that Jon Tester and I are TIED at 46% each, your personal endorsement is more important now more than ever. In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign each time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. On the battlefield, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the highly trained combat warriors I served alongside as a Navy SEAL. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. And believe me, there are some tales. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why Our homeland is in danger. Radical Democrats in Washington want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream. The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to flip the Senate this year is to nominate a strong conservative candidate who can defeat my liberal Democrat opponent in less than five months. Over the weeks ahead leading up to the election, you’ll receive emails from me and my team as we work to defeat entrenched liberal Senator Jon Tester. While I don’t want you to feel obligated to interact with each piece of content you receive in your inbox, I kindly ask you to refrain from unsubscribing from our contact list. The only way to flip the Senate this year is if we are all working toward the same mission. *If we fail to flip this Montana seat RED this November, we lose our best chance at a Senate Majority for the next DECADE due to the election map at play. I'm a retired Navy CAPT who spent 25 years fighting for our country in some of the most dangerous battlegrounds in the world. My family and I came to America when I was just four years old after my father was put on a kill list in Communist Vietnam. If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I owe my life to this country - so I paid her back by attending the Naval Academy after graduating high school and dedicating my career to serving America. I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia where I defused IEDs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces. I performed some of the most dangerous dives in the military all around the world. It wasn't easy, and there were many times where my life flashed before my eyes. But it was worth it, because I was protecting this country so the next generation could have the same opportunities that I did. Now that Democrats are trying to destroy that American Dream, I'm not about to sit by idly. Our fight isn't just overseas anymore. It's right here in America, where far-Left liberals in Washington DC are working to erode your freedom and compromise our future. I'm not a career politician. # [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2913%2E35263%2EGxEFu5)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun24.Hijekx&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240627_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2913%2E35263%2EGxEFu5) Hey Peter, it’s John. Have you heard about what Republicans are cooking up in Wisconsin’s battleground Senate race? Mitch McConnell handpicked a right-wing California megamillionaire to run against Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin. _Yup, you read that right._ 🙄 California bank owner, Eric Hovde, might be running for Senate in Wisconsin, but his California ties run deep — think $7M Laguna Beach mansion 🌴, owner of a $3 billion California bank 💸, Orange County mainstay 🍊 — you get the picture. body:
Peter, We’re excited to invite you to join an exclusive live broadcast of the Common Ground Podcast this Sunday at 11:00AM ET
|
---
| Peter, This Saturday, Governor Murphy and President Biden will convene in Middletown for a fundraiser, starkly reminding us where their true loyalties lie—not with the hardworking people of New Jersey, but with their own campaign funds. **Governor Murphy is prioritizing his political aspirations and those of Joe Biden above the critical needs of our state.** As New Jersey's budget deadline looms ominously this weekend, our governor is not battling in Trenton for us; instead, he's schmoozing in Middletown, supporting a presidency that has delivered nothing but skyrocketing inflation and economic instability. **If you've had enough, join us this Saturday, make your voice heard loud and clear at the "Bidenomics = Bad Economics Rally," presented by Jersey 1st and AFP New Jersey.**

---
|
---
We're gathering to send a resounding message against the failing economic policies of President Biden and Governor Murphy. **Details of the Rally:**
* Date: Saturday, June 29th, 2024
* Time: 4 PM
* Location: Intersection of Navesink River Rd & Blossom Cove Rd, Middletown Township, NJ 07701

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Do you have the kind of friends that you can volunteer with?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
To me, I think the test of a community is — whether it’s physical or digital — are you there for one another? Because this is how we deepen meaning in our lives.
Let's say you reposted something — that’s wonderful. Let's say you showed up to a protest. That’s great, too.
But when the signs are put down and we all go home, what is lasting? Do you have the kind of friends that you can volunteer with?
I represent Rikers Island, which is a horrific jail. It’s probably one of the largest sites of human rights violations for the incarcerated in the United States. And there are a lot of people that post about this, a lot of people that show up to protest this. But when I think about efforts in this space, I think of the people who have, for example, gathered toys to send to children of the incarcerated. They will coordinate letters from their parents that may be incarcerated.
They’re actually healing bonds and trauma in our community. It is something that requires actual relationship. And that can _seem_ really, really hard to get involved in. But it is also some of the most transformative experiences we can have.
One of the most important things to communicate is that **there is no action that’s too small.**
I think sometimes people talk themselves out of things because they feel like: “What can my one letter do? What can my one call to Congress do? What can my one donation or me showing up to a toy drive, or me showing up to an event _actually_ do?”
It does a lot. Because it inspires other people to show up. **It’s like each drop in the ocean thinking that it’s meaningless, when it’s actually the most powerful force on the planet.**
And that’s the key. If you’re speaking up online, that’s wonderful. How are you integrating this into your life?
That, I think, is where we start to see real change happen.

Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

clean_body: To me, I think the test of a community is — whether it’s physical or digital — are you there for one another? Because this is how we deepen meaning in our lives. Let's say you reposted something — that’s wonderful. Let's say you showed up to a protest. That’s great, too. But when the signs are put down and we all go home, what is lasting? Do you have the kind of friends that you can volunteer with? I represent Rikers Island, which is a horrific jail. It’s probably one of the largest sites of human rights violations for the incarcerated in the United States. And there are a lot of people that post about this, a lot of people that show up to protest this. But when I think about efforts in this space, I think of the people who have, for example, gathered toys to send to children of the incarcerated. They will coordinate letters from their parents that may be incarcerated. They’re actually healing bonds and trauma in our community. It is something that requires actual relationship. And that can seem really, really hard to get involved in. But it is also some of the most transformative experiences we can have. One of the most important things to communicate is that there is no action that’s too small. I think sometimes people talk themselves out of things because they feel like: “What can my one letter do? What can my one call to Congress do? What can my one donation or me showing up to a toy drive, or me showing up to an event actually do?” It does a lot. Because it inspires other people to show up. It’s like each drop in the ocean thinking that it’s meaningless, when it’s actually the most powerful force on the planet. And that’s the key. If you’re speaking up online, that’s wonderful. How are you integrating this into your life? That, I think, is where we start to see real change happen. Thank you for reading. ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/sam%20and%20trish.jpg]
Canvass for Sam and Trish!
*this is a place holder until the new facebook event is created*
Join us Sunday to canvass for Sam and Trish! Meet our Field Coordinator, Dom, on September 3rd at the Williamson Road Library, 12:00pm.
Located at 3837 Williamson Rd, Roanoke, VA 24012.
IN THE COMMUNITY

Roanoke River Contamination Settlement Reached Roanoke Young Democrats Canvass Tailgate
Without current regulations, the water contamination caused by these companies could have been so much worse. Come out to support Roanoke Valley Democratic candidates!
Read More [https://roanoke.com/news/local/source-of-forever-chemical-in-roanoke-river-to-pay-1-billion-settlement/article_da6f7bca-598f-11ee-881b-8bac139e59c4.html?fbclid=IwAR1qjW8zAjGrPndXAdQUujaypWNYnxc5JZCyD7FVTO7RJLbp9BBceVPyfq4#tracking-source=home-top-story] The Roanoke Young Democrats will be enjoying pizza, coffee, donuts and more before canvassing to knock for Trish White-Boyd, Sam Rasoul, Lily Franklin, Samantha Newell, Jade Harris, & Nancy Horn. Door knocking will begin about 12:30 pm!
Read More [https://www.facebook.com/events/275519338709424]
Roanoke EnVision Center Kids Movie Night - Sept. 28 Fall Harvest Festival
The movie is free and there will be snacks and much more! Fall into wellness at the Harvest Festival!
Read More Celebrate the end of farm season with fun experiences for the whole family. Try new activities to support your well-being. Connect with others in a beautiful outdoor space. Free meals available with registration. This event is free and open to everyone!
Read More [https://web.cvent.com/event/19422342-be4f-417d-9fc3-6a6bf883e794/summary]
https://www.facebook.com/events/3583390115210992 [https://www.facebook.com/events/3583390115210992] https://roanokehiddenhistories.org/ [https://roanokehiddenhistories.org/]
Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011
Read More [https://www.facebook.com/events/3583390115210992] Read More [https://roanokehiddenhistories.org/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RCDC.jpeg] Join the Roanoke City Democrats!
Roanoke City Democratic Committee meetings are now in-person and open to non-members. We meet the 3rd Thursday of each month. This month we are meeting at 6 pm at the Main Library (706 S Jefferson St, Roanoke, VA 24016). Sign up for meeting reminders and other information here [https://www.roanokedemocrats.com/subscribe] .
Join us for a social hour every first Thursday of the month at Leonore Restaurant, 128 Campbell St. SW, 5-7 pm.
Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]
Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.
Contact: YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com [YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com] to get involved!
Donate Today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/samrasoul]
Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime.
My very best,

* She asked, _“Are you my Congressman?”_
* * I said, _“Yes ma'am, I am.”_
* * She told me, _“I’m Melissa, and I should tell you, I support President Trump.”_
* * She explained the concerns of what she was seeing on Fox News and I nodded along. But then she said something you might not expect:
* * _“I am really glad the way you voted with the farmers.”_
* * I smiled. Bridging the gap between differing perspectives is an essential part of my job.
* * _“Ma’am, I voted with the farmers,”_ I replied.
* * She followed up, _“And you support our troops and veterans too, don’t you?”_
* * I nodded again. _“Yes, ma’am.”_
* * She smiled and said, _“I think I’m gonna vote for you again.”_
* * _“Thank you, ma’am.”_

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. clean_body: This is one of the top seats targeted to flip from blue to red in 2024, and it’s a vital part of our strategy to protect and expand our GOP House majority. | Hi, fellow conservative, I just want to take a second to re-introduce myself. I’m a Marine Corps veteran, blue-city Republican mayor, husband and father running for Congress in California’s battleground 9th District. This is one of the top seats targeted to flip from blue to red in 2024, and it’s a vital part of our strategy to protect and expand our GOP House majority. That’s why Speaker Mike Johnson and House Republican leaders are backing my campaign. In our primary, more voters cast their ballot for a Republican than for my Democrat opponent, Josh Harder. Now, House Democrats have placed Harder in their most vulnerable category – they know they’re in trouble. We’re locked in a tight race, and every advantage is needed to pull ahead and flip this seat. Can I count on your support? Semper Fi, Kevin Lincoln Veteran, USMC GOP Nominee, CA-9 | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. name: Neil Parrott
subject: Doesn't the person with the best ideas normally win?
body:
Doesn’t the person with the best ideas win an election? Unfortunately, not always. In order to win an election, voters have to see your name 7 times | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a91db50b55)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Doesn’t the person with the best ideas win an election?

Unfortunately, not always.

In order to win an election, voters have to see your name 7 times to remember it. We have to buy Signs, Mailings, Advertisements, Bumper stickers, T Shirts, digital marketing, and pizza for volunteers! (among other things...)

Reaching people who vote takes a herculean effort, and you can help to MAKE IT HAPPEN from the comfort of your own home! Can you pitch in today?

Any amount would help – Could you send $15, $50, $100 or even $250 right now? You can be the ultimate **_Armchair Warrior_** , just by clicking the button below!
---
| [Donate to Parrott for Congress](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=2ba9f32356&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to Parrott for Congress")
---
| | We have the right ideas.

We want to close the border to keep violent criminals from entering freely. We want to stop deadly drugs from being smuggled into our country.

We want to be wise with spending, cutting irresponsible expenditures so our country doesn’t go further into debt. We want to reduce inflation so that eggs and bread do not cost a small fortune.

We want to make sure that parents determine their children’s education, not government bureaucrats who are trying to push a radical, heavily sexualized agenda to grade school kids.

**We have a serious, financial deadline of June 30, which is this weekend. ** Be the Armchair Warrior so that we can buy what we need to reach voters! I promise that we will use the funds wisely to make sure that voters hear our good ideas.

Let’s go! For our country,
Neil

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, take a look
at a few of the headlines to come out since progressive champion Rep.
Jamaal Bowman lost his primary against an AIPAC-backed career politician
on Tuesday:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240627.2-2Sv3&refcode=em20240627-35499&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35499%2E1203867%2Eu7rVq9 ]The Hill: Bowman loses New York primary in blow to progressives

House seat. George Latimer has won the primary election for New York’s
16th congressional district, after the most expensive House race ever.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240627.2-2Sv3&refcode=em20240627-35499&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35499%2E1203867%2Eu7rVq9 ]USA Today: Jamaal Bowman’s primary results may spell trouble for other
Squad members

There’s no doubt: we lost a powerful voice for everyday people in Congress
this week, and we need to rally together now to stop it from happening
again.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240627.2-2Sv3&refcode=em20240627-35499&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=35499%2E1203867%2Eu7rVq9 ]We’re rushing to build the grassroots resources needed to re-elect
Justice Democrats incumbent and Squad member Cori Bush in her August
primary against another one of AIPAC’s hand-picked challengers. Can you
rush $5 now to fuel our fight?

There are a lot of hot takes out there about what led to this devastating
loss, but here are the three key takeaways from the most expensive primary
in U.S. history:

1. AIPAC, its super PAC, and other right-wing outside groups used our
broken campaign finance system to funnel more than $20 million from
Republican millionaires and billionaires into this primary against a
Democratic incumbent.

2. Gerrymandering took a toll here as well, with Jamaal’s district
shifting to include fewer voters in the Bronx and more in Westchester
suburbs. While Jamaal’s opponent won 69% of the Westchester County
vote, Jamaal secured a massive 84% majority of voters in Bronx County.
This district was purposefully cut to exclude Black and brown voters
from it.

3. If AIPAC and George Latimer’s platform was so popular, it wouldn’t
have taken a historical amount of dark money for them to win this
seat. Our progressive, people-powered movement is a threat to the
status quo, which is why they had to spend so much to defeat us in
this race.

With a little over a month until Cori’s primary, we can’t sit around and
let AIPAC oust another member of the Squad with their war chest.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240627.2-2Sv3&refcode=em20240627-35499&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1005&akid=35499%2E1203867%2Eu7rVq9 ]Unlike AIPAC, we are powered by people like YOU. Please pitch in any
amount today to support our work to re-elect Cori, protect the Squad, and
stop AIPAC from setting our progressive movement back.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240627.2-2Sv3&refcode=em20240627-35499&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1024&akid=35499%2E1203867%2Eu7rVq9 ]Contribute $5

Growing up in New Hampshire taught me that democracy isn’t something you watch happen from the sidelines – it’s something you participate in. When I was two years old, my mom Betty ran for this same Congressional seat. You know what her opponent’s slogan was? A woman’s place is in the home, not in the House. Can you believe that? Friend, I’m in the business of history. I have devoted decades of my life to making films that tell America’s stories and remind people of our vast and complicated past so we can better understand where our nation is – and, perhaps more importantly, where we are going.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the global conflicts of the First and Second World Wars to the darkest days of the COVID-19 pandemic, these pivotal moments have tested our republic and forced us to reckon with the promise that defines the fabric of our nation – the responsibility to preserve a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all of its citizens.
In November, our country faces another crossroads, and to me, this is a choice that could not be clearer. The democratic principles that have long been the bedrock of our nation are at risk, and the results of the November elections will have profound consequences for each of our futures.
**That’s why I’m reaching out to you today to ask for[ _your support_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87721931/482046048/-1278658170?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4029-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTkwYWE2Zi1hNzM0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7KPMU8qaxx0VriofWt7-epG-k8FtxwpdV_gBW2KkAo=) in reelecting Senator Jacky Rosen in one of the most competitive battleground states in 2024.**
We need leaders like Jacky in the Senate, who will tirelessly fight for hardworking families across the country, defend fundamental reproductive rights, and uphold our democracy in the face of unprecedented attacks.
Winning her race won’t be easy. Nevada’s last Senate race was decided by just 7,928 votes – the closest margin of any Senate election in 2022 – and Republicans are targeting her race with millions of dollars worth of attack ads. She will need every dollar she can get to compete and protect her vulnerable seat. [**So I’m asking again: Will you help meet this moment by chipping in $5 to Jacky Rosen’s campaign ahead of her critical fundraising deadline?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87721932/482046049/-1278658170?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4029-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTkwYWE2Zi1hNzM0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7KPMU8qaxx0VriofWt7-epG-k8FtxwpdV_gBW2KkAo=)

name: Team McBride
subject: This is going to be public!
body:
Our end-of-quarter deadline is only 3 days away, and we still have quite a bit of ground to make up!
#
It’s happening! 🚨
**Our end-of-quarter deadline is only 3 days away, and we still have quite a bit of ground to make up!**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240627-1?refcode=em20240627-1-711&amount=5&refcode2=711_21716_PXFcAv&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240627-1?refcode=em20240627-1-711&refcode2=711_21716_PXFcAv&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)**
June 30 is a really important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline for most political campaigns — but it’s especially important for ours. **It’s our final end-of-quarter deadline before the primary and filing deadline.**
This is our campaign’s biggest test yet! Our campaign is required to submit a public fundraising report to the Federal Elections Commission (FEC) with all of the donations made to our campaign by midnight on June 30th. The GOP and other outside groups will use that report to gauge how much money they will need to defeat us.
**Meeting our $25k email fundraising goal is the best way to show folks the true strength of our movement AND remain in a competitive place to send Sarah to Congress in November. 💪**
So today, we have to ask: [**With only 3 days to go before the deadline closes, will you make a $5 – or whatever amount you can afford – donation to our campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240627-1?refcode=em20240627-1-711&amount=5&refcode2=711_21716_PXFcAv&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)
_Every donation made before the clock strikes midnight on June 30 will be included in our public EOQ fundraising report._
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240627-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240627-1-711&refcode2=711_21716_PXFcAv&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)**
We really can’t tell you how much we appreciate anything you can send our way today. 💙
Team McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240627-1&t=1&refcode2=711_21716_PXFcAv&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=2&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=3&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=711%2E21716%2EPXFcAv)

Email us: [info@sarahmcbride.com](mailto:info@sarahmcbride.com)

Peter: This week, the eyes of the world will be on the presidential debate stage. I know a little something about what that’s like and what’s at stake, and I can’t wait to watch President Biden make his case to voters that he’s the only candidate who cares about protecting our pocketbooks and our freedoms. At the same time, it’s important to remember: **Our success in 2024 requires more than just winning the presidency.** We need to elect candidates up and down the ballot who will fight for every American, not just themselves and their wealthy friends. What happens in state legislatures, state supreme courts, and in key ballot initiatives this year will shape our future — not just on critical issues like abortion rights and access to the ballot, but also who gets to draw electoral maps and who decides how fair they will be. The future of our democracy is bigger than one campaign — and that’s exactly why I’m working with the National Democratic Redistricting Committee to target top-priority races across the country. **Will you make a grassroots donation to the NDRC today?** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

We’ve seen how this country can slide backwards. Two years after _Roe_ was overturned, some states are making it harder to access birth control. And as we wrap up Pride Month, it’s important to remember that state legislators introduced a record number of anti-LGBTQ laws last year.
Given all this, it can be easy to feel cynical — to lose some of that energy that drives us forward. I’m so grateful for people like you who refuse to give up. You keep fighting for what’s right, whenever and wherever it’s necessary. That’s something I’ll never take for granted.
Right now, that means making investments and inroads in races up and down the ballot.
**I believe that if we each do our part, we _will_ look back on the 2024 election and say that this was the moment we stood tall for the future of our democracy. The right-wing group hand-picked Jamaal’s anti-ceasefire opponent because Jamaal has been an outspoken advocate for Palestinians’ human rights. AIPAC represents the biggest source of Republican money going into Democratic elections, undermining our democracy. Because of AIPAC’s Trump-supporting billionaire donors, Jamaal’s race was more expensive than any Congressional primary ever. Now, AIPAC’s planning to spend another $20 million to defeat Rep. Cori Bush between now and her August 6th primary election in Missouri. The group already sent her anti-ceasefire opponent $2 million and its affiliates are running attack ads against Cori. We can’t let AIPAC’s Trump-supporting billionaire donors take down any more members of our progressive Squad in Congress. Cori Bush is one of the strongest progressives in Congress and a champion for marginalized communities. Meanwhile, her anti-ceasefire opponent—who’s already one of the top recipients of AIPAC money—once ran the campaign of a far-right anti-abortion Republican. We can’t afford to lose any more progressive champions in Congress; instead we need to build power to make sure our government invests in our communities rather than in genocide. Back in October of last year, Cori heeded the call from the grassroots to introduce a Congressional resolution demanding a ceasefire and humanitarian aid to Gaza. Like Jamaal, Cori was one of the first members of Congress to correctly refer to these attacks on Palestinians as ethnic cleansing and genocide. In 2014 Cori met Palestinian activists on the streets of Ferguson, Missouri while protesting for Black lives, and she saw the connections between Black and Palestinian struggles against state violence. Since then, she’s criticized the U.S. government’s complicity in Israel’s human rights abuses. In Congress, Cori and I have advocated against ever-growing spending on police and military budgets , all while our communities are struggling to put food on the table and keep a roof over their heads. We need more elected officials in office who recognize our shared humanity and who see Palestinians as human beings. subject: I know a thing or two about tough elections

body:
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27185?t=1009&amount=25&akid=1914%2E52803%2ELngYNP ][IMG]

Peter, I know a thing or two about tough elections.

Maryland might seem like an easy win for Democrats, but in 2024 that
couldn’t be further from the truth.

Maryland could decide if Democrats keep control of the U.S. Senate, so
Republicans are willing to spend anything or do anything to defeat Angela
Alsobrooks.

I can say this with the utmost confidence: Angela Alsobrooks has what it
takes to lead Maryland forward and fight for all of our rights in the
Senate.

From serving as state’s attorney to navigating Prince George’s County as
County Executive, Angela shows up and leads her community every step of
the way – in good times and bad.

Now, Angela is running for Senate in one of the most important
battleground races of 2024 and needs us to show up for her campaign. She’s
up against Republican Larry Hogan, who was handpicked by Mitch McConnell
and recently endorsed by Donald Trump. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27185?t=1010&amount=25&akid=1914%2E52803%2ELngYNP ]Will you chip in $25 or more to
help Angela make history and keep Maryland’s open seat and the U.S. Senate
in Democratic control?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27185?t=1011&amount=25&akid=1914%2E52803%2ELngYNP ]Donate

Angela's opponent isn’t just another “far-right” candidate. Larry Hogan is
a former governor who is well known in Maryland. He’s also got the full
backing of the GOP and super PACs that are already rushing millions into
the state to boost his campaign.

Larry Hogan is going to be a fierce competitor, but so is Angela
Alsobrooks. With so much on the line like abortion rights, LGBTQ+ rights,
voting rights, and our democracy as we know it, we must give this race our
full attention.

Recent polling has this race neck-and-neck so who wins in November will
come down to who’s got the message and the resources to get voters to the
polls.

That’s why I’m reaching out today and asking you to join Angela’s campaign
and help her keep Maryland blue. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27185?t=1012&amount=25&akid=1914%2E52803%2ELngYNP ]Can I count on you to chip in $25 or
more today? Angela is up against a critical FEC filing deadline at the end
of this month, so donating now will have a huge impact on this race.

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

Peter,
The first presidential debate of 2024 is only hours away. Tonight's debate will undoubtedly mark a crucial test for President Biden and Donald Trump.
**But there’s a real argument to be made that the most important test is how the news media, social media platforms, and fact-checkers will deal with Donald Trump and the lies he will try to spread from the debate stage tonight. **
[**We’ll explain more in a moment, but if you’re ready to help us safeguard democracy by fact-checking Donald Trump’s debate performance tonight in the communities and online spaces where misinformation thrives, please contribute $25 or more today. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87727362/482062652/-593472309?refcode=20240627-EM-DebateDay&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTVkNmE2NmYtYWYzNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=czjMTvL4eovYed9i8Yt3hvn69sh2Fx_0z4TbGsGUsnM=)
We already know what _Fox News_ , Republican politicians, and right-wing influencers like Tucker Carlson will do with Trump’s lies. In moments like these, they cowardly double down, amplifying Trump at all costs. Democracy and country be damned.
If the 2016 and 2020 elections are any indication, legacy media and social media platforms like _X_ and Facebook won’t do much better. Many are still stuck in an outdated “both sides” frame, afraid to call out Trump’s autocratic routine because it might hurt their clicks, ratings, and profits.
So that’s the bad news. But, the good news is that, no matter how the media responds to Trump tonight, COURIER’s network of battleground state newsrooms will be there to fight back and correct the record in real-time.
**Florida, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Nevada, Arizona—these states will decide this year’s presidential election. In those states, and more, our talented teams are on the ground right now providing trustworthy, and freely available election coverage to local communities where right-wing misinformation is thriving. **

| I am writing to you today as an advocate for women's rights and as someone who is committed to advancing the causes that affect women the most. Our nation stands at a critical juncture, and now more than ever, _we need leaders who will champion policies that promote equality, safety, and opportunity for all women._

I support issues that are vital to the well-being of women, including:

**Reproductive Rights:** Ensuring that women have access to comprehensive reproductive health care, including contraception and safe, legal family planning services and that health insurance companies are covering this vital care.

**Equal Pay:** I will advocate for legislation that mandates equal pay for equal work, aiming to close the gender pay gap that persists in many industries.

**Healthcare Access:** It is crucial we expand access to quality healthcare for women, particularly maternal health services, and addressing disparities that disproportionately affect women of color.

**Combating Violence:** Strengthening laws and support systems to protect women from domestic violence, sexual assault, and harassment, both in the workplace and beyond.

**Economic Empowerment:** Supporting policies that provide women with opportunities for education, job training, and entrepreneurship, helping to lift families out of poverty.

I am committed to do the hard work required, However, I cannot do this without the help of dedicated individuals like you.

Campaigns require resources to reach voters, spread our message, and counteract the opposition's efforts. Today, I am asking for your support in the form of a donation to my campaign.

**Your contribution, whether it is $5, $25, $100, or more, will make a tremendous difference.** It will enable us to amplify our voice, advocate for critical issues, and ensure that women's concerns are heard and addressed in Georgia and at the highest levels of government.

Please consider making a donation. Every dollar counts and brings us one step closer to a future where women's rights are fully recognized and protected. Thank you for your time and your commitment to these important issues.

# Together, we can make a difference!

Warm regards,
Liz

**With Joe Manchin’s retirement taking West Virginia’s Senate race off the board, our Senate race here in Missouri is the perfect candidate to replace it.**
